title: Team leader_ BID Position
description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India’s valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency.
   

  

 Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
   

  

 Context
   

  

 In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations.
   

  

 Our unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Our fully integrated services are tailored to plan and manage projects using proven best practices.
   

  

 Systra India's design business line is the leading design team for metros, highways, special bridges, Urban Planning and water projects in India. The team has designed over 900 kms of viaduct \& Bridges along with 43 kms of tunnels and 82 underground stations, 345 Elevated \& at\-grade Stations, 19 Depots besides 300 plus stations being designed currently. The team has also completed 3,165 km of highways detail design projects and 22,506 km of design/ feasibility projects. The team has also worked on detailed design for Drainage and Utilities, design of WTP and STP etc.
   

  

 We are also very proud to have designed the first monopile in India for the Mumbai Coastal Road project. We have the distinction of designing the fastest implemented metro project in the country with Lucknow and now have broken the record in Kanpur Metro. Apart from Indian projects the team also provides design services to projects as far as Philippines in the east to Columbia in the West.
   

  

 We are also conversant with BIM (Building Information Modelling) which enhances all stages of the infrastructure life cycle, from design to construction and maintenance, which is why we integrate it into our projects and offer it to our clients. Our design team has extensive exposure to both domestic and international markets, contracts, codes and specification.
   

  

 We are seeking applications for the position of Team Leader for the upcoming Urban Planning project.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and manage the overall project execution and delivery.
* Provide strategic and technical guidance to the project team.
* Review land\-use analyses, demographic assessments, socio\-economic studies, and infrastructure planning reports.
* Ensure integration of sustainable and resilient urban development principles.
* Manage multidisciplinary experts including planners, architects, engineers, GIS specialists, environmental experts, and economists.
* Review all reports, presentations, GIS outputs, and planning documents before submission.
* Ensure adherence to national, state, and local planning regulations and guidelines.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Minimum 20 years of professional experience in urban planning, town planning, regional planning, city development, infrastructure planning, or related fields.
* Graduate Degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Planning, or Geography. Post Graduate Degree in Urban Planning, Town Planning, City Planning, Regional Planning, or equivalent.
* Expertise in master planning, regional planning, and infrastructure planning.
* Excellent project management and leadership skills.


 We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job \- it’s a career!
   

  

 Workplace Type
   

  

 On\-site

title: Drydock Manager
description:
Seaspan employees are goal\-driven and thrive in a high\-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life\-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long\-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry\-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
   

  

**Position Description:**
 This position is responsible for the end\-to\-end planning, execution, and financial oversight of vessel drydocking and major repairs including unplanned and retrofits across a global fleet. The position serves as the primary technical link between the company, shipyards, and classification societies to ensure the dry\-dock projects are delivered safely and on schedule.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities:** 
  

  

* Is familiar with the Health, Safety, Environmental Protection and Quality Policy (PL\-005\), and understands the responsibilities under the Environmental Management System (EMS). In keeping with this and other compliance policies, they understand their duty to report any environmental noncompliance and/or concern to their manager or members of the senior management team (including the highest level of management) either directly or through the open reporting system as per Management System guidelines.
* Project Planning \& Preparation: Lead the pre\-planning phase, including pre\-docking inspections, developing detailed technical specifications (standard and non\-standard), and coordinating with vessels and vessel managers to identify specific repair needs. Making sure Seaspan vessels are docked at the most suitable and economical shipyard, at the most appropriate time and in the most cost\-effective manner. Liaising with the vessel to order spares and stores prior docking in a timely manner. Liaising with the procurement team and local agency to ensure timely and cost\-effective delivery of spares required for project execution.
* Shipyard \& Vendor Management: Review shipyard quotations for accuracy \& include missing items in the bid sheet, conduct cost/availability comparisons, and provide recommendations. Manage relationships with paint suppliers, subcontractors, and service providers.
* On\-site Supervision: With the support of Vessel Managers, oversee all stages of drydock execution at the shipyard to ensure high\-quality workmanship, adherence to timelines \& budgets, and compliance with safety and environmental standards (QSHE). Assist Vessel manager in resolving operational issues to minimize downtime and delays
* Financial Control: Along with the Vessel Manager, manage the overall repair budget, monitor project expenses in real\-time, and lead final invoice negotiations with the shipyard to identify cost\-optimization opportunities. Variations in docking scope to be documented and approvals sought from relevant stakeholders. Ensure Maximum value from allocated Dry\-dock budgets and costs saving potentials are harvested. Preparing 5\-year CAPEX rolling budget forecast for the fleet with Vessel Managers. Analyze docking costs and invoices to identify cost optimization opportunities. Follow up with service vendors for any variation in repair cost.
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all work meets the requirements of classification societies, flag states, and international maritime regulations.
* Process Improvement: Improve and maintain standardized drydock procedures, software, and databases to track historical costs and performance metrics in line with industry\-wide best practices.
* Documentation \& Reporting:
+ Maintain dry\-dock records, inspection reports, and repair logs
+ Ensure document control and compliance with audit requirements


**Requirements:**
* Education: Degree in Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, or a related discipline.
* Professional Experience:


* 
+ Minimum 5–8 years of experience in ship management, superintendency, or shipyard project management.
+ Proven track record of managing large\-scale drydocking projects and retrofits
+ Sailing experience as a Senior Engineer (e.g., 2nd Engineer or higher) is preferred.
+ Technical Skills:


  

  

* 
+ Proficiency in drydock management software, ERP systems, and project management tools. Technologically driven, comfortable working in a digital environment, logical process development.
+ Leveraging data and system functionality to improve decision\-making and operational performance.
+ Focus on standardization, continuous improvement, and workflow optimization across technical and operational activities.


**Core Competencies:**
* Project Management: Ability to manage complex, multi\-million\-dollar projects under tight deadlines.
* Negotiation: Assertive skills for handling shipyard contracts and final settlements.
* Communication: Strong interpersonal skills to coordinate with cross\-functional teams, including fleet operations, marine assurance, procurement, and accounts.
* Mobility: Readiness for frequent international travel on short notice and ability to conduct physical vessel inspections.


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**
* Drydocking Planning Performance: Percentage deviation from planned costs and duration.
* Budget Alignment: Preparing competitive budget. Total project spend versus allocated budget.
* Vessel Turnaround Time: Minimizing downtime and ensuring on\-time or before\-time delivery from the yard.
* Safety \& Quality: Number of health, safety, and environment (HSE) incidents or quality findings during the project.
* Corrective Actions \& Continuous Improvement: Demonstrates management commitment to continual improvement


 Seaspan Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

* Experience delivering enterprise Fraud, Financial Crime, or Compliance solutions within Banking, Financial Services, FinTech, or Payments organizations.
* Experience leading technical workstreams and working directly with customers, business stakeholders, and technology teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within regional and global delivery teams.

 Opportunity to work in a dynamic and rapidly growing e\-commerce environment

title: Principal Engineer - Civil (UK Water)
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
   

  

 We are more than 36,000 people, in over 70 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
   

  

**Role description:**
 Our Water Design and Engineering team is involved in some of the UK’s most complex and stimulating projects that are diverse and technically demanding. We have an excellent reputation in the delivery of such schemes and are working closely with some of the UK’s most established and recognisable companies, undertaking a vast array of projects to enhance the UK’s water infrastructure and environment.
   

  

 As a Principal Engineer \- Civil, you will be a key technical leader within our multidisciplinary delivery teams working on a variety of water and wastewater capital projects, having the opportunity to apply your expertise to projects for our clients regionally and across the UK.
   

  

 Reporting to the Associate Technical Director/Technical Director, you will be responsible for technical delivery of the project\-related tasks to meet budget, timeframe and quality targets, meeting, or exceeding client expectations, promoting and marketing all facets of Arcadis' services during interfaces with clients and other sectors and disciplines, contributing towards the achievement of the divisional business plan and building networks within the industry.
   

  

 To be considered for a role we are seeking candidates with the following credentials:
   

  

**Role accountabilities:**
* Owning and managing day\-to day technical delivery
* Overseeing the development of multiple colleagues working on complex projects across multiple disciplines
* Managing the production and verification of analysis and design, including drawings, calculations and reports.


 Sound work experience in the UK water sector for the following, but not limited to,
   

  

* Water and Wastewater Treatment plants
* Pumping stations and pipelines
* Combined Sewer Overflows
* Water and wastewater conveyance systems
* Flood Protection Facilities
* Drainage systems
* Hydraulic design related to above including hydraulic calculations (using HADES software will be added advantage)

* Engaging in the creative and innovative development of engineering technology and continuous improvement of systems
* Supporting and collaborating in the development of team training plans and make a major contribution to upskilling and training.
* Provide design input to CAD/BIM and co\-ordinate with CAD/BIM staff for preparation of drawings.
* Liaison with other team members to produce good design solutions as per best design practice.
* Carry out buildability checks and add value to the design development process.
* Compliance of Arcadis business management system.
* Awareness of Sustainability Best Practices
* Awareness of digital strategies and takes interest and initiatives aligning towards digitalization.
* Familiarization with client specific specifications, processes, and technical preferences.
* Proactively engaging and participating with the relevant Communities of Practice.


**Other Competencies** 
 .
   

  

* Practical experience in Design \& Engineering, Design \& Build projects in the UK water sector for the following, but not limited to,
* Non\-Linear assets (e.g., Treatment Plants, Combined Sewer Overflows \& Pumping Stations)
* Experience in Linear Assets/ Utilities – clean and waste
* Nature Based Solutions and SUDS will be an added advantage.
* Producing and reviewing hydraulic calculations, specifications, drawings and reports
* Working Knowledge of HADES software will be added advantage
* Ability to review buildability of proposed solutions independently and challenge designs.
* Familiar with British and other international standards and practices.
* Demonstrate ability to lead complex projects.
* Health \& Safety Management, awareness to CDM regulations.
* As an experienced professional you will be professionally qualified or, actively working towards it.
* Awareness and applications of Civil 3D, Revit, BIM and Information management.
* A strong, self\-motivated and assertive person capable of working under pressure.
* Well\-developed interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively at all levels and across regions.
* Flexible to adopt new work /challenging work as per business requirement.
* Awareness of Sustainability best practices.
* Good communication skills.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* Around 10\+ years of experience and having a BSc/BEng or MSc/MEng or equivalent in a relevant discipline.

title: Engineering Leader
description:
Your Job
   

  

 As a Senior Lead – Mechanical Engineering, you will provide leadership and direction to a team of mechanical engineers, lead engineers, and designers supporting the design and execution of engineered\-to\-order products within John Zink's global engineering organization. You will be responsible for building team capability, driving engineering excellence, improving execution discipline, and partnering with global stakeholders to deliver innovative, safe, reliable, and cost\-effective solutions that create long\-term value for customers and the business.
   

  

 Our Team
   

  

 You will be part of the John Zink global engineering organization supporting combustion and emissions\-control technologies across multiple industries. Our team collaborates closely with engineering, manufacturing, project management, supply chain, quality, and business stakeholders worldwide to deliver industry\-leading solutions while fostering a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and value creation.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

 Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and designers while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
   

  

 Build organizational capability by identifying development opportunities, creating growth plans, and strengthening leadership readiness within the team.
   

  

 Partner with global stakeholders to drive successful execution of complex engineering projects and strategic initiatives.
   

  

 Improve engineering effectiveness through standardization, knowledge sharing, quality processes, and continuous improvement efforts.
   

  

 Promote engineering solutions that prioritize safety, manufacturability, reliability, customer value, and operational excellence.
   

  

 Influence cross\-functional teams and stakeholders to achieve business objectives and deliver superior outcomes.
   

  

 Support transformation initiatives that enhance engineering productivity, innovation, and design quality.
   

  

 Champion Koch's values and Principle Based Management™ by empowering individuals, encouraging constructive challenge, and driving value creation.
   

  

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**
 Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
   

  

 14\+ years of experience in mechanical engineering, equipment design, product engineering, or engineered\-to\-order project execution.
   

  

 5\+ years of experience leading engineers, designers, technical teams, or complex engineering workstreams.
   

  

 Experience developing talent, improving team performance, and influencing outcomes across cross\-functional organizations.
   

  

 Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, engineering documentation, fabrication processes, and design\-for\-manufacturing practices.
   

  

 Experience collaborating with global stakeholders in a matrixed engineering environment.
   

  

 Strong communication, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and decision\-making skills.
   

  

 What Will Put You Ahead
   

  

 Experience in combustion systems, emissions\-control technologies, oil \& gas, petrochemical, process equipment, pressure equipment, or heavy industrial industries.
   

  

 Familiarity with burners, flares, thermal oxidizers, vapor control systems, or similar engineered equipment.
   

  

 Experience leading engineering transformation, standardization, automation, digital engineering, or process improvement initiatives.
   

  

 Advanced degree (Master's, MBA, or equivalent) or formal leadership development training.
   

  

 Experience working across global engineering centers and manufacturing locations.
   

  

 Demonstrated success in developing future technical and people leaders.
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 John Zink, a Koch Engineered Solutions (KES) business, is a global combustion and emissions\-control partner delivering engineered solutions such as industrial burners, flares, thermal oxidizers, vapor control systems, and related services. The organization combines deep technical expertise, proven execution capability, and a culture of innovation to help customers solve complex industrial challenges safely, reliably, and efficiently.
   

  

 At Koch, employees are empowered to apply Principled Entrepreneurship™, challenge the status quo, and create long\-term value for customers, the company, and themselves. This role will be based in Navi Mumbai and will support global engineering and design execution across the John Zink Combustion business.

title: Technical Service Manager (TSM) - Maritime, Mumbai
description:
**About Us**
 We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
   

  

 As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
   

  

**About Maritime**
 We help enhance the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of our customers in the global shipping industry, covering all vessel types and mobile offshore units. As a partner to industry, we offer services in testing, certification, training, and technical advisory through the energy value chain. That means we’re continually investing heavily into R\&D for new services and solutions while proactively assessing what the industry needs today and tomorrow.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Be the primary liaison for assigned Key Accounts on technical and operational matters which cannot be solved neither by DATE, nor by the Operational Centres or the surveyor network. Help the assigned Key Accounts maintain smooth technical operations and continuous vessel trade by providing personal attention, outstanding competence and added value in identifying, solving and advising the customer on those technical and operational issues in alignment with DNV’s purpose, business objectives and principles.
   

  

 The result is that you maintain and develop a trustful win\-win relationship and contribute to high customer satisfaction and loyalty which build an important foundation for DNV to maintain a high quality fleet, successfully retain existing business and secure new business.
   

  

 Team up with the relevant Key Account Manager (KAM) and work collaboratively with the Account Team and all relevant departments within DNV to ensure that excellent technical customer service levels are delivered.
   

  

 Be an important part of the Key Account Planning and Implementation process to help the KAM prepare and execute a high\-impact Key Account Plan, Account Strategy and Actions that adds value to the customer and to DNV. Provide input to the KAM on the Key Account\`s technical needs and expectations, relevant technology and regulatory developments, suitable strategies and actions related to the Key Account\`s technical issues and technical operations. Help implement the assigned actions according to plan.
   

  

 Develop and strengthen the customer relationship, operating at the Key Account\`s technical department and technical management levels, to achieve preferred supplier status based on lasting personal relationships and the added value delivered.
   

  

 Solve and advise on operational requests, customer technical concerns and technical complaints related to survey and audit performance in close collaboration with relevant technical experts and the KAM to ensure continuous vessel trade. Hand over customer requests to DATE or Operations Centres in case the requests fall into the service scope of those units.
   

  

 Systematically identify any major technical and technical operation challenges and technical concerns related to the DNV interaction with the Key Account and cascade to the KAM and to relevant departments within DNV. Follow\-up with the findings and ensure that related improvement activities are executed under utilization of the relevant DNV organization.
   

  

 Bring in foresight and help spot and resolve potential technical problems before they occur.
   

  

 Consult the customer on technical matters in meetings, presentations and workshops together or in alignment with the KAM and relevant stakeholders within DNV .
   

  

 Train, guide and consult the Key Account on rules and regulations as well as on new tools and new work processes to help them leverage the full value of our solutions and to facilitate customer's planning and implementation into operations.
   

  

 Measure and monitor the Key Account\`s performance on critical technical key performance indicators, address and support improving performance gaps by developing adequate plans and actions in alignment with the KAM and the relevant DNV organization as well as the Key Account.
   

  

 While your focus is on technical issues, remain attentive towards identifying potential business opportunities and hand those over to the KAM.
   

  

 Pro\-actively stay up to date with relevant industry, regulatory and technology trends and best practices as well as with the relevant DNV products, services, processes and tools to remain relevant towards the Key Accounts.
   

  

 Liaise with Indian flag for Flag related matters.
   

  

 Experience working with MOU’s is an added advantage.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

* Flexible work arrangements for better work\-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check\-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On\-The\-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.


 DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
   

  

**About You**

* Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

 Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country\-specific laws and practices.

title: Human Resources:Learning & Development Team
description:
**Role Description**
**About Human Resources:**
 The HR department handles a range of different functions within an organization like hiring and recruiting, training and development, compensation, developing and overseeing employee benefits, promoting employee career development and addressing current employee concerns. The HR Department is responsible for finding talented manpower and placing them in right jobs in the Bank.
   

  

**About the Role:** 
**Learning Content Innovation**
**AI \| Content Systems \| Learning Content \| Analytics**
**Location:** 
 Mumbai
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

 Reimagine how learning content is understood, consumed, designed and created.
   

  

 The role will rethink how complex knowledge is translated into effective learning experiences, design reusable content frameworks and systems, build AI\-enabled creation workflows, and prototype new formats that improve learning effectiveness, quality, speed and scale.
   

  

 This is not a conventional course\-development or learning journey design role. It is a hands\-on builder role at the intersection of learning and content expertise, AI, technology and data.
   

  

 The person should be equally comfortable asking “How can people understand and use this better?” and “Can we build a framework, agent or system that solves this at scale?”
   

  

 What You Will Own 1\. Content Innovation, Frameworks \& Systems
   

  

* Design content systems, architectures, frameworks, templates and playbooks that others can use across learning journeys.
* Translate learning and content principles into practical tools and workflows that make good design easier to execute consistently.
* Experiment with new content formats and interaction models, moving beyond conventional e\-learning and video.
* Design modular and reusable content that can be adapted across roles, channels, formats and learning contexts.
* Convert promising prototypes into reusable, documented and scalable content solutions.
* Identify recurring content problems and solve them through frameworks, standards, automation or systems rather than one\-off fixes.
* AI Agents \& Creation Workflows
* Build, test and continuously improve AI agents, prompts, instructions, knowledge resources and multi\-step workflows for learning\-content creation.
* Design effective human\-AI ways of working, including review points, guardrails, validation mechanisms and escalation logic.
* Use AI to accelerate and improve content analysis, research, scripting, assessment, media ideation, quality review and repurposing.
* Design AI workflows that understand and apply learning frameworks rather than simply generate fluent content.
* Evaluate AI outputs critically for factual accuracy, instructional value, content depth, usability and consistency.
* Determine where human judgement is essential and where AI or automation can safely improve speed and scale.
* Rapid Prototyping \& Technology
* Turn ideas into working proofs of concept using generative AI, low\-code tools and basic coding.
* Rapidly prototype new learning\-content experiences before committing to full\-scale development.
* Work with APIs, structured data and automation to connect tools and reduce repetitive manual effort.
* Understand and work with structured formats such as JSON and data\-driven content systems.
* Troubleshoot workflows with a strong debugging and problem\-solving mindset.
* Stay model\-agnostic and tool\-agnostic, selecting the simplest technology that solves the problem well.
* Evaluation, Data \& Governance
* Create rubrics and evaluation methods for content accuracy, instructional value, usability, consistency and learner relevance.
* Define what 'good' looks like for AI\-generated and human\-created learning content.
* Analyse quality, productivity, adoption and content\-performance data to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Design experiments to compare content formats, workflows and approaches rather than relying only on subjective preference.
* Establish feedback loops so that evidence from usage and learner performance improves future content.
* Document standards and ensure responsible, compliant and enterprise\-ready use of AI.
* Content Analysis \& Knowledge Structuring (Occasionally)


 Build an understanding of the content development process.
   

  

* Analyse complex business, product, process and policy content to determine what learners need to know, understand, practise and do.
* Transform complex or fragmented SME inputs into clear, structured and meaningful learning content.
* Identify gaps, duplication, contradictions and unnecessary complexity that could affect learning effectiveness.
* Structure knowledge into appropriate concepts, processes, decision rules, examples, scenarios and practice opportunities.
* Distinguish need\-to\-know from good\-to\-know and determine the right depth of content for the learner, role and learning objective.
* Work with SMEs to clarify and strengthen source content where information is incomplete or insufficient for the intended learning outcome.
* Rapidly develop enough understanding of unfamiliar domains to make sound content and learning\-design decisions.


 Core Capabilities
   

  

**CAPABILITY**
**What We Expect**
**Content Analysis \& Judgement**
 Analysis, synthesis, knowledge structuring, gap identification and simplification without loss of meaning
   

  

**Learning \& Content Design**
 Content architecture, instructional fundamentals, objectives, assessment, scenarios, practice and modularity
   

  

**AI \& Agents**
 Prompt and instruction design, agent workflows, knowledge bases, evaluation, guardrails and human\-AI design
   

  

**Building \& Automation**
 Rapid prototyping, low\-code automation, basic Python, APIs, JSON, structured data and debugging
   

  

**Data \& Insight**
 Excel/Power BI, experiment metrics, and quality, productivity, adoption and learner\-performance analysis
   

  

**Innovation \& Systems Thinking**
 Framework design, pattern recognition, scalability and conversion of prototypes into reusable systems
   

  

 What We Are Looking For
   

  

* 5–8 years of experience, with a strong foundation in learning content/content design, and demonstrated experience in one or more of digital learning, AI solutions, product or experience design, technology, analytics or innovation.
* Strong ability to analyse, synthesise and structure complex information into clear and usable learning content.
* Evidence of frameworks, products, prototypes, tools or systems built, not only courses or presentations produced.
* Hands\-on experience with generative AI tools and agentic workflows. Experience with Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude or similar platforms is valuable.
* Ability to evaluate whether content is accurate, sufficient, relevant and instructionally sound, rather than accepting SME inputs at face value.
* Strong writing and content judgement, with the ability to explain complex ideas simply without oversimplifying them.
* Ability to learn unfamiliar business domains quickly and ask SMEs the questions required to uncover gaps and assumptions.
* Comfort with experimentation, ambiguity, critique, failure and rapid iteration.
* Curiosity about emerging learning, AI and technology possibilities, combined with the judgement to distinguish useful innovation from novelty.


 The Person We Need
   

  

 The person we need sees a complex content problem and does not immediately ask:
   

  

**“What course should I create?”**
**They Ask**
* “What does the learner actually need to understand or do?”
* “Is the content making an impact?”
* “Is the source content sufficient and accurate?”
* “What new trends can I adopt to build content consumption and impact?”
* “Can I build a framework, agent, tool or system that solves this better at scale?”

**Our Talent Philosophy** 




 At Star Union Dai\-ichi Life Insurance, we will ensure to nurture our people and provide opportunities to learn, succeed and build careers to the best of their abilities, thus creating and unlocking value for self, the organization, and the society at large.
 



  





**About The Role** 




**Role: Technical Lead \- Data \& AI** 




**Function:** 
 IT – Strategy, Digital \& AI
 



**Role Level:** 
 Manager
 



**Experience:** 
 5–7 years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a technically strong and delivery\-oriented Manager for the IT Data \& AI team who can own end\-to\-end API development, cloud\-enabled application integration, infrastructure coordination, and application governance. The ideal candidate should be hands\-on with modern technology stacks while also being capable of managing internal teams, vendor\-driven applications, security tracks, and operational uptime for business\-critical platforms.
 



 This role requires a balanced mix of technical depth, team leadership, vendor governance, cloud exposure, and production operations discipline. The candidate should be able to design, build, govern, monitor, and continuously improve APIs and related systems across multiple technologies while ensuring scalability, security, and reliability.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 API Development \& Integration Ownership
 


* Own end\-to\-end API development lifecycle including requirement understanding, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, versioning, and production support.
* Design and develop secure, scalable, and high\-performance APIs across different technology stacks, including RESTful APIs, microservices, and integration services.
* Define API standards, reusable templates, naming conventions, authentication mechanisms, logging practices, and documentation norms.
* Work closely with business teams, data engineering teams, application teams, and external partners to enable seamless system\-to\-system integrations.
* Ensure APIs are built with proper error handling, monitoring, retry logic, throttling, access control, and performance optimization.



**Team Management \& Technical Governance** 



* Manage and guide a team of developers, engineers, and support resources responsible for API development, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancement.
* Review technical designs, code quality, deployment readiness, release plans, and production support processes.
* Set up governance processes for API inventory, ownership, documentation, access controls, monitoring dashboards, and periodic health reviews.
* Ensure adherence to internal IT processes, change management, incident management, vulnerability remediation, and audit requirements.
* Mentor team members on modern engineering practices, cloud technologies, secure coding, automation, and operational excellence.



**Application Supervision \& Vendor Management** 



* Supervise vendor\-driven applications owned or supported by the Data \& AI team, ensuring timely delivery, stability, compliance, and production readiness.
* Track vendor deliverables, open issues, release plans, defects, SLAs, escalations, and closure status.
* Coordinate with vendors for application enhancements, bug fixes, regression testing, deployment planning, and post\-production support.
* Ensure applications are aligned with enterprise architecture, security standards, infrastructure norms, and business continuity expectations.
* Drive structured reviews with vendors and internal stakeholders to ensure accountability, transparency, and measurable outcomes.



**VAPT, Security \& Compliance Governance** 



* Own and govern the VAPT track for applications, APIs, servers, and platforms under the Data \& AI team.
* Coordinate with information security, infrastructure, vendors, and application teams for vulnerability identification, remediation, retesting, and closure.
* Track security observations, risk ratings, target dates, exception approvals, and audit evidence.
* Ensure API and application development follows secure coding, access management, data protection, encryption, authentication, and authorization best practices.
* Maintain compliance documentation and periodic status reporting for management reviews, audits, and internal governance forums.



**Cloud, Infrastructure \& Server Uptime Management** 



* Coordinate provisioning and management of infrastructure required for APIs, applications, data platforms, and AI\-related workloads.
* Work with cloud and infrastructure teams to manage environments across Azure and GCP, including compute, storage, networking, identity, access, monitoring, and backup requirements.
* Track internal server uptime, performance, capacity, patches, alerts, incidents, and preventive maintenance activities.
* Ensure proper monitoring, logging, alerting, and escalation mechanisms are in place for production systems.
* Support cloud adoption, modernization, automation, and cost\-conscious infrastructure planning for Data \& AI initiatives.



  





**Required Technical Skills** 



* Strong hands\-on experience in API development, integration architecture, microservices, REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and API security.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms, especially Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform.
* Exposure to cloud services such as compute, storage, networking, identity management, serverless services, monitoring, logging, and security controls.
* Good understanding of application deployment, CI/CD practices, DevOps ways of working, version control, release management, and environment management.
* Experience with databases, SQL, application integrations, data flows, and basic data engineering concepts.
* Understanding of VAPT, vulnerability remediation, secure coding practices, access controls, encryption, audit trails, and security governance.
* Ability to read, review, and challenge technical designs, architecture documents, API specifications, and vendor solution proposals.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience in insurance, BFSI, fintech, or regulated enterprise technology environments.
* Exposure to API gateways, Azure API Management, Apigee, Kong, MuleSoft, or similar integration platforms.
* Knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, Docker, serverless architecture, event\-driven integrations, and cloud\-native design patterns.
* Understanding of data platforms, analytics systems, AI/ML application integration, and enterprise reporting ecosystems.
* Certifications in Azure, GCP, cloud architecture, DevOps, security, or API management will be an added advantage.



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* 5–7 years of relevant experience in API development, application integration, cloud technology, infrastructure coordination, or application support governance.
* Minimum 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in API development or application integration projects.
* Experience in managing small technical teams, vendors, production applications, and cross\-functional IT initiatives.
* Prior experience in regulated environments with security, audit, VAPT, and compliance requirements will be preferred.

* To provide functional knowledge with hands\-on experience in electricity, gas and water utilities.

* Drive Business Workshops, Blueprint Sessions, develop BBPs/BBDs FS, Test Scenarios, conduct Trainings, perform Testing and provide defect management support for Device Management module

* Should understand different business processes in the Utility Industry (Regulated and Deregulated)

Carries out hydraulic calculations, analysis and investigations for clients using Infoworks WS Pro software for modelling projects and tasks, including preparation of reports, figures and other documents to a high level of grammatical and technical presentation.

* Projects a credible image and inspires confidence; Excellent interpersonal skills.

* Active commitment to continuous personal improvement.
* A team player and considers the views of others.

* Consistently demonstrates trustworthiness, integrity, professionalism and honesty.
* Natural and confident leader displaying openness, accountability, decisiveness and engagement; Client centric and passionate about service excellence .

Description

* Purpose of This Role: A Project Manager's role spans the full lifecycle of an order to ensure opportunities and service projects are executed smoothly, delivering projects on time, within budget, and achieving business goals and high customer satisfaction.
* Scope \& Coverage: Manages end\-to\-end execution, scheduling, resource planning, and PMO governance for service projects across Neptunus offerings—including Engine Condition Monitoring Systems, Oil Quality Management Systems, dewatering/pump packages, and mechanical asset maintenance.

 Home Care Fabric Cleaning is a \~7 Bln Euro Business. Within that, Fabric Cleaning Powders is a \~4 Bln Euro business and continues to drive value creation through superior, sustainable, and affordable products enabled by differentiated technologies from Partner programs, bespoke technical, instrumental, and digital capabilities underpinned by strong consumer insights. To do this, (S)he is expected to have a good understanding of technologies and the partnership ecosystem. A solid grounding in digital ways of working and application of digital tools to unlock speed and efficiency for the program is desired.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 The incumbent will deliver to the following key workstreams of the “future fit” Powders program.
   

  

* Digital: Define and drive clear Digital targets for the team (Data capture in LIMS, model adoption). Work closely with DRD partners to identify opportunities for impactful model creation and democratization.

 Education and Experience: Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or Master's in Chemistry from a reputed institute. Experience in FMCG formulation design is preferred.
   

  

* Core Skills: Curiosity and willingness to learn and apply new Science \& Technology (including Digital) to the Powders program. Resilient to challenges and consistent focus on the goal.

title: R&D Packaging Leader
description:
**Job Location**
 MUMBAI GENERAL OFFICE
   

  

**Job Description**
 P\&G was founded over 180 years ago as a simple soap and candle company. Today, we're the world’s largest consumer goods company and home to iconic, trusted brands that make life a little bit easier in small but meaningful ways. We've spanned three centuries thanks to three simple ideas: leadership, innovation and citizenship. The insight, innovation and passion of hardworking teams have helped us grow into a global company that is governed responsibly and ethically, that is open and visible, and that supports good causes and protects the environment. This is a place where you can be proud to work and do something that matters.
   

  

**Dedication from Us:** 
 You'll be at the core of breakthrough innovations, be given exciting assignments, lead initiatives, and take ownership and responsibility, in creative workspaces where new insights thrive. All the while, you'll receive outstanding training to help you become a leader in your field. It is not just about what you'll do, but how you'll feel: encouraged, valued, purposeful, challenged, heard, and inspired.
   

  

**What we Offer:** 
 Continuous mentorship – you will collaborate with peers and receive both formal training as well as day\-to\-day mentoring from your manager dynamic and encouraging work environment– employees are at the center, we value every individual and support initiative, promoting agility and work/life balance.
   

  

**Overview Of The Job**
 We are seeking a Packaging Product Research \& Innovation Leader to drive consumer\-centric packaging innovation. This role involves translating deep consumer insights into superior packaging solutions that meet technical, quality, sustainability, and business requirements. The leader will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams and external partners to identify, develop, and commercialize innovative packaging. This role will require extensive domestic and sometimes international travel.
   

  

**Your team**
 This role will work closely with cross\-functional teams including Product Research/Product Development (PR/PD), Brand, Analytics \& Insights (A\&I), Design, Engineering (P\&E), Supply, Manufacturing, Quality, Purchasing, and Supply Chain teams, as well as external suppliers.
   

  

**Responsibilities Of The Role**
 Develop and bring to life consumer\-centric packaging solutions including:
   

  

* Develop deep consumer understanding to identify unmet needs and opportunities for packaging innovation.
* Partner with PR/PD, Brand, A\&I, and Design teams to translate consumer insights into packaging requirements, design principles, and technical solutions.
* Lead packaging consumer learning plans, consumer testing, and evidence generation to support key business decisions.
* Drive packaging innovation from concept through commercialization, ensuring solutions are consumer\-centric, technically robust, manufacturable, and scalable.
* Build organizational capability by integrating consumer understanding into packaging development and innovation processes.
* Lead IMP projects and packaging technical learning plans from idea generation through qualification and commercialization.
* Identify and implement packaging savings opportunities while maintaining product quality and consumer experience.
* Collaborate closely with P\&E, Supply, Manufacturing, Quality, Purchasing, and Supply Chain teams to deliver business objectives.
* Identify and leverage supplier capabilities, external technologies, and emerging packaging trends to deliver consumer\-centric, new packaging technologies, materials, solutions and competitive advantage.
* Lead technical problem\-solving and drive resolution of packaging, quality, manufacturing, and supply challenges in collaboration with suppliers and multifunctional teams.


**Role Requirements**
* Technical Problem Solving \& Innovative Critical Thinking: Ability to guide technical project direction, critically analyze complex problems, and enable innovation to create new products, processes, or capabilities through packaging expertise.
* Strategic Leadership: Skill in developing and leading iterative learning plans, setting clear priorities for technical plans, and integrating diverse approaches like first\-principle modeling and resource planning.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Influence: Capability to build effective relationships, collaborate across disciplines, and leverage internal/external resources.
* Business Acumen \& Continuous Learning: Understanding of the business context, basic commercialization aspects, and a commitment to continuous learning on P\&G systems and procedural elements.
* Technical Documentation: Skill in thoroughly documenting learnings and insights.


**About Us**
 We produce globally recognized brands, and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head \& Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral\-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.
   

  

 Visit http://www.pg.com to know more.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor

**Job Qualifications**

* Packaging Expertise: In\-depth knowledge of materials, packaging engineering, and translating consumer needs into superior packaging experiences.

title: Program Manager - RLP
description:
**PROGRAM MANAGER — RURAL LIVELIHOODS PROGRAMME**
 Job Title \- Program Manager — Rural Livelihoods Programme
   

  

 Office Location \-Mumbai (field\-based)
   

  

 Job Type \- Full\-Time
   

  

 Reports to \- Senior Rural Livelihood Lead
   

  

 Manages \- Block Coordinators (1\), Field Officers (5\), Divyang Mitras (5\)
   

  

 Salary \- ₹50,000 \- 60,000/month \+ travel allowance
   

  

**About The Project**
 Sol's ARC is a disability inclusion organisation with over 23 years of experience enabling Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) to access education, livelihoods and employment. We work with governments, donors and communities to create systemic, scalable and sustainable change.
   

  

 The Rural Livelihoods Programme (RLP) in Maharashtra is an initiative. The programme aims to strengthen the economic and social empowerment of Persons with Disabilities in rural Maharashtra — connecting 400 PwDs to identity documents, government schemes, SHGs, livelihood training and market linkages across demonstration districts.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Program Manager will serve as the operational backbone of the Maharashtra RLP and facilitate the government and donor interface, the Program Manager will drive field\-level implementation, ensuring that programme activities are delivered on time, to the expected quality, and with meaningful outcomes for PwDs.
   

  

 This is a senior field\-facing role requiring a balance of hands\-on implementation and programme management. The person will spend significant time in the field—observing, mentoring, coaching, verifying data, and resolving implementation challenges—alongside planning, reviewing progress, analysing data, and reporting to the senior team.
   

  

 The role will focus on supportive supervision to maintain the quality and efficiency of field implementation. This will include regular mentoring visits to oversee data collection, assess quality and timeliness, provide hands\-on coaching to field teams where required, and establish a consistent cadence of reviews and check\-ins with the senior team. The Program Manager will proactively identify and address emerging challenges, ensuring timely course correction and minimising avoidable escalations.
   

  

**What Will You Typically Do?**
* Field Delivery and Quality Assurance
* Oversee day\-to\-day programme delivery across demonstration blocks — ensuring Block Coordinators and Field Officers are meeting their weekly and monthly targets.
* Conduct regular field visits to verify data quality, observe field staff at work and provide hands\-on coaching and support.
* Ensure that PwD identification, SHG enrolment, government scheme linkages and livelihood initiation activities are progressing as planned.
* Identify implementation challenges and resolve them — escalating to the State Lead only when necessary.
* Team Management and Capacity Building
* Manage and guide 1 Block Coordinators and 5 Field Officers — conduct weekly team meetings and individual check\-ins.
* Train field staff on PMIS tools, SHG facilitation, household survey methodology, livelihood modules and entitlement documentation.
* Review field staff data submissions for accuracy and completeness — provide real\-time feedback and correction.
* Support Block Coordinators in managing their respective communities and resolving ground\-level challenges.
* Livelihood and SHG Programme Management
* Lead and support the implementation of all necessary skill training sessions to support livelihood activity across the programme area.These may include, but may not be limited to Entrepreneurship Development Program, farm and non\-farm livelihoods, SHG management, among others.
* Oversee SHG formation, monthly meeting facilitation and financial inclusion activities for PwDs.
* Coordinate disability access camps — working with government departments to bring schemes and services to communities.
* Support market linkage development — connecting PwD\-produced goods and services by establishing forward and backward linkages.
* Establishing convergence with livelihood support schemes from departments like NABARD, Agriculture etc to support livelihood activities of PWDs.
* Monitoring, Reporting and Documentation
* Ensure PMIS data is entered accurately and on time by the field team — conduct bi\-monthly data quality checks.
* Prepare weekly and monthly field progress reports for the State Lead.
* Maintain field documentation — SHG registers, livelihood tracking sheets, beneficiary consent forms and activity records.
* Support the M\&E Manager with baseline and endline data collection processes.
* Collate timely narrative and financial reports as per pre\-determined milestones.


**How Will Your Success Be Measured?**
**KPI** 
**Success Measure**
**Team performance** 
 Block Coordinators and Field Officers meet targets with quality
   

  

**Data quality** 
 PMIS data complete, accurate and submitted on time; bi\-monthly quality checks pass
   

  

**Quality assured Programme delivery** 
 All key activities implemented as per applicable SoPs and Checklists.PwD identification, SHG enrolment and livelihood initiation on track against quarterly targets
   

  

**Livelihood outcomes** 
 Minimum 240 PwDs initiating income\-generating livelihoods by Year 3
   

  

**Reporting** 
 Weekly and monthly field reports submitted to State Lead on time
   

  

**SHG functioning** 
 SHGs active, meeting regularly, PwDs attending and contributing
   

  

**Who Are We Looking For?**
* Has 4–6 years of experience in rural livelihoods, SHG\-based programmes or community development — with at least 2 years in a supervisory or team management role.
* Has experience working with government livelihood systems — MSRLM, NRLM or similar — at the block or district level.
* Is comfortable managing a field team across multiple villages and communities.
* Can use PMIS/MIS systems for data entry, tracking and reporting.
* Communicates clearly in Marathi and Hindi; comfortable reporting in english.
* Believes that Persons with Disabilities have the right to participate, earn and make their own choices.
* Is willing to travel regularly across project blocks and districts in Maharashtra.

Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.


**Job Responsibilities**
* 7\+ years of onsite clinical monitoring experience
* Good experience of Site selection, site initiation, and site activation
* Client Office based opportunity in Mumbai
* Should be able to act as the primary point of contact for sites
* Strong oncology experience is mandatory
* Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close\-out visits (performed on\-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH\-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiologic Practices (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site\-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and with guidance develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
* Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
* For the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes, conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records, verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete, applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines, utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical project data review and capture, verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements
* May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
* Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations
* Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow\-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
* For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site\-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt, with the oversight of the Lead CRA, to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
* May act as primary liaison with project site personnel, or in collaboration with another CRA or Central Monitoring Associate (CMA). Ensures all assigned sites and project\-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements.
* Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
* Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow\-up actions.
* For Real World Late Phase, the CRA I will use the business card title of Site Management Associate I. Additional responsibilities include: Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close\-out Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs Chart Abstraction activities and data collection Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff.


**Get to know Syneos Health**
 Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.
   

  

 No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
   

  

 http://www.syneoshealth.com

**Summary**
 Roles within the Clinical Trial Management job family are responsible for overseeing the development, coordination, and implementation of Phase 1 clinical research studies at the organization's facilities. Individuals in these roles collaborate closely with the principal investigator, serve as liaisons between research subjects, client teams, investigators, and clinic operations teams, and meticulously plan logistics and resource usage. description:

**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* Knowledge of sequence of activities, durations, resource requirement and progress monitoring methods. for various construction activities.

* Proficient in MS Office and Primavera.
* Team Player, interpersonal skills.

We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
   

  

 And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

**About the Role** 




 Our client, a leading global FMCG organization, is seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Logistics Functional Lead with expertise in Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) and Transportation Management (TM) to join a major S/4HANA transformation program in India. This is a full\-time, 12\+ month on\-site assignment in Mumbai.
 



**Position Summary** 




 As the SAP S/4HANA Logistics Transformation Lead, you will play a pivotal role in guiding the client through a significant logistics transformation. You will leverage your deep functional knowledge of SAP logistics solutions and your experience in large\-scale transformations to ensure a successful transition to S/4HANA.
 



**Location:** 
 On\-Site \- Mumbai
 **Work Mode:** 
 Full Time
 **Duration:** 
 12\+ months
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead As\-Is process mapping for Warehouse Management and Transportation Management across India sites and distribution centers.
* Design the migration path from Centralized Warehouse Management (CWM) to Embedded S/4 EWM.
* Lead the migration from SAP TM to S/4 Advanced Transportation Management.
* Configure core EWM functionalities, including warehouse structure, goods movement, inventory management, and RF/Fiori transactions.
* Design the freight collaboration solution using SAP Logistics Business Network (LBN).
* Drive data quality assessment for logistics master data.
* Coordinate with 3PL partners and logistics service providers for system transitions.



**Requirements and Qualifications** 



* MBA in Supply Chain / Operations from a Tier 1 B\-School (e.g., NITIE, IIT Bombay, SP Jain, or other Tier I institutions).

* 8–12\+ years of SAP functional experience with deep expertise in WM, EWM (Embedded and/or decentralized), and SAP TM.
* At least 2 full end\-to\-end SAP implementations involving warehouse and/or transportation management workstreams.
* Hands\-on knowledge of EWM configuration: warehouse structure, goods movement, RF transactions, Handling Unit Management, and Physical Inventory.
* Proven experience with SAP Transportation Management, including freight planning, execution, carrier collaboration, and freight settlement.
* Total Experience: 10\+ years.



**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience with CWM to EWM migration (Embedded EWM) is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with SAP LBN (Logistics Business Network) for freight collaboration.
* Knowledge of SAP Yard Management and dock scheduling.
* Experience with RF/Barcode scanning and Fiori\-based warehouse transactions.
* Understanding of India logistics regulations and compliance requirements within the SAP context.
* Exposure to SAP Activate methodology and agile delivery frameworks.



**Industry:** 
 FMCG, IT Services \& Consulting
 



**Additional Skills:** 
 Logistics, SAP Transportation, Supply Chain Operations, CWM, SAP LBN, S4/HANA, SAP TMS, Embedded EWM, SAP Implementation.

title: Senior Mechanical Commissioning Engineer - Data Center
description:
At FPC Global, our people are our greatest asset. We’re a fast\-growing, global consultancy where collaboration, innovation, and ambition come together to deliver exceptional outcomes across the full facility lifecycle.
   

  





 Founded in 2014 by our CEO, Dean Francis, we’ve grown into a team of 140\+ professionals working across the Americas, EMEA, APAC, and our London headquarters. We partner with clients to deliver integrated, future\-focused consultancy services—setting new benchmarks for sustainability, technology, and performance.
   

  





 We believe great ideas can come from anywhere. That’s why we foster a culture where voices are heard, initiative is encouraged, and careers are built with purpose.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We’re thrilled to announce that, due to recent project wins, we have several exciting roles opening up across our team, all of which are available to start immediately
   

  





 We’re specifically interested in hearing from candidates with
 **strong data center experience** 
 , so if this is your area of expertise, we’d love to connect.
   

  





 If you’re ready to take the next step in your career, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  





 The Role:
   

  





 The CX Mechanical Engineer is responsible for the planning, execution, and management of commissioning activities for mission\-critical
 **mechanical systems** 
 within hyperscale data center environments. This role ensures that all mechanical and thermal infrastructure is installed, tested, integrated, and handed over in full compliance with project requirements, safety standards, and operational objectives, supporting high\-availability and energy\-efficient operations.
   

  





 The responsibilities for this role include, but are not limited to, the following:
   

  





**Commissioning Management**



* Lead and manage the end\-to\-end commissioning process for mechanical systems, from pre\-functional testing through integrated systems testing (IST) and final handover.
* Ensure commissioning activities are executed in accordance with approved commissioning plans, project schedules and quality standards.
* Coordinate phased and systems\-based commissioning strategies typical of hyperscale delivery model



**Mechanical Systems Testing \& Validation**




 Commission and validate critical mechanical infrastructure, including but not limited to:
   

  




* Chilled water systems (chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers)
* Airside systems (CRAC/PAHUs, AHUs, FWUs)
* Direct\-to\-chip, liquid cooling, or hybrid cooling systems (where applicable)
* HVAC distribution systems (ductwork, piping, valves, dampers)
* Fuel oil and lube oil systems supporting standby generation
* Make\-up water, water treatment, and blowdown systems
* Verify system performance under normal, abnormal, and failure conditions.
* Validate thermal performance, capacity, control response, and efficiency against design intent and client requirements.



**Project Coordination \& Oversight**



* Plan, coordinate and lead mechanical commissioning activities in collaboration with design engineers, construction teams, vendors, controls specialists and operations stakeholders.
* Act as the primary technical authority for mechanical commissioning issues on site.
* Support construction readiness, system turnover and commissioning sequencing in fast\-track hyperscale environments.



**Mechanical \& Controls Integration**



* Ensure seamless integration of mechanical systems with:
   

  




	+ Electrical power systems
	+ Controls, BMS, and EPMS
	+ Fire/life safety systems
	+ IT load and white\-space requirements
* Validate system redundancy (N, N\+1, 2N), fault tolerance, and maintainability to support mission\-critical operations.
* Lead functional performance testing and integrated systems testing involving mechanical failure scenarios.



**Documentation \& Reporting**




 Develop and manage commissioning documentation, including:
   

  




* Commissioning plans and schedules
* Mechanical test procedures and functional performance scripts
* Method statements and risk assessments
* Final commissioning reports, as\-built records and handover documentation
* Provide clear, accurate progress, risk and readiness reports to project and client stakeholders.



**Standards \& Compliance**



* Ensure all mechanical systems and commissioning activities comply with applicable codes, standards and best practices, including:
   

  




	+ ASHRAE (including TC 9\.9\)
	+ CIBSE, SMACNA, IPC
	+ IEC, ISO, and local authority requirements
	+ Uptime Institute Tier Standards
	+ TIA\-942 and client\-specific hyperscale standards
* Support third\-party audits, peer reviews and certifications where required.



**Factory \& Site Acceptance Testing (FAT \& SAT)**



* Plan, coordinate and lead FAT and SAT activities for mechanical equipment and packaged systems.
* Review vendor submittals, test data and corrective actions to ensure equipment readiness for site installation and integration.
* Witness performance testing of major plant (chillers, PAHUs, cooling towers, packaged plant).



**Risk Management \& Troubleshooting**



* Identify technical, schedule, operational and safety risks related to mechanical commissioning.
* Implement mitigation strategies and lead root\-cause analysis and troubleshooting to resolve issues efficiently.
* Support rapid issue resolution in live or partially energized data hall environments.



**Health, Safety \& Environmental Compliance**



* Demonstrate a strong understanding of mechanical and process safety, particularly when working with:
   

  




	+ Pressurized systems
	+ Rotating equipment
	+ Chemical treatment systems
	+ Live data center environments

title: Senior Engineer - Carbon Management (Roads)
description:
**Job Description**
 Your Team
   

  

 Our Roads Net Zero team sits within our wider Roads group and guides clients and colleagues through transport and infrastructure decarbonisation, embedding carbon thinking at the heart of our projects.
   

  

 We deliver carbon assessment and management for transport infrastructure projects; quantifying and assessing carbon to inform strategies and plans, provide carbon management reporting and develop carbon management policies and advice for clients.
   

  

 Since its inception three years ago, our Transport Net Zero team has led industry change—authoring the Department for Transport’s Quantifiable Carbon Reduction guidance; working with Sub‑National Transport Bodies to develop baseline emissions models and support regional decarbonisation strategies; advising local authority clients; and developing carbon management policies for major transport programmes and organisations.
   

  

 As one of the largest suppliers of professional services to various clients, we influence change through client engagement, we invest heavily in R\&D to drive innovation across decarbonisation and climate resilience. Our current frameworks and strategic partnerships spanning National Highways (SDF), National Gird (GGP) work and other frameworks provide a strong platform for impact and growth.
   

  

 Joining the team at this critical time for climate action presents a great opportunity to influence transport policies, shape WSP’s and our client’s decarbonisation approaches, and play a meaningful role on the national pathway to net zero.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 You will be responsible for:
   

  

* Leading and support carbon management inputs for highways and multidisciplinary infrastructure projects across all stages of design.
* Acting as the Carbon Lead on projects, embedding PAS 2080 principles, coordinating low\-carbon solutions with the Client, ECI contractors and suppliers.
* Challenging designs to identify opportunities for carbon reduction and climate resilience.
* Developing and apply carbon assessment methodologies, governance and tools.
* Advising clients on low‑carbon innovation and climate‑resilient opportunities. Identifying and implementing innovative processes and materials for projects.
* Contributing Net Zero inputs into strategic pursuits and proposals, including coordinating and preparing technical and commercial responses.
* Helping build WSP Net Zero process, fostering a collaborative, 'carbon conscious' culture across our Roads and wider T\&I teams.
* Supporting technical development and upskilling of colleagues, including technical leadership and assurance of deliverables
* Contributing to continual improvement and business development within the Roads Net Zero team and National Carbon management activities.
* Reporting achieved carbon reductions back to the client through internal WSP carbon processes.


**Qualifications**
 What we will be looking for you to demonstrate…
   

  

* 
* Experience in carbon assessments and management of transport infrastructure, including familiarity with PAS 2080
* Muiti\-discipline Experience in infrastructure projects in design life cycle including construction
* Experience in technical leadership of projects, with an associated client facing role
* An understanding of the principles of Net Zero in a transport context
* Confidence in working in complex project teams (often cross\-discipline) and ability to upskill staff on best practices in carbon reduction
* Good written and verbal communication skills
