**Education** 



* Graduate in Civil Engineering.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Degree or Diploma in Management.
* PMP Certification.
* Post Graduate Specialization.



**Experience** 



* Approximately 6 to 8 years of relevant experience within the real estate industry.
* Experience working on reputed construction projects with responsibility for procurement and contracting activities.
* Demonstrated experience handling civil and interior procurement packages and contract finalization



**Knowledge \& Technical Expertise** 



* Procurement and contracting of civil and interior work packages.
* Interpretation and evaluation of drawings and BOQs.
* Contractual terms, conditions, obligations, and contract administration.
* Management of contract variations, claims, NT items, and disputes.
* Knowledge of safety protocols and regulatory requirements.
* Understanding of project procurement and contracting functions.
* Knowledge of NBC and BIS codes, contract laws, and regulations.



**Core Competencies** 



* Procurement Management
* Contract Management
* Technical Evaluation
* Commercial Negotiation
* BOQ Analysis
* Contract Administration
* Risk Assessment
* Regulatory Compliance
* Market Analysis
* Stakeholder Management
* Planning \& Coordination
* Construction Procurement



**Success Indicators** 



* Effective procurement and contract finalization of civil and interior packages.
* Timely completion of procurement and contracting milestones.
* Management of contract variations and claims with minimal project impact.
* Compliance with contractual, regulatory, and project requirements.
* Successful stakeholder coordination throughout procurement cycles.
* Adoption of industry best practices and market intelligence in procurement decisions.
* Maintenance of quality, commercial, and governance standards across procurement activities.



**Personal Attributes** 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with close attention to detail.
* Excellent negotiation and communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Strong capability in contract interpretation, drafting of contract conditions, and administration.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced project environment.
* Proficiency in MS Office and procurement tools, including e\-tendering platforms.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively across teams.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India.

title: Clinical Lead
description:
**About Lyra**
 Lyra Health is the leading provider of mental health solutions for employers supporting more than 20 million people globally. The company has delivered 13 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 20 peer\-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness and cost efficiency. Extensive peer\-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life\-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI\-powered platform combining the highest\-quality care and technology solutions.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Clinical Governance \& Quality Assurance
* Framework Implementation: Lead the implementation and ongoing adherence to Lyra’s global clinical governance framework and quality standards within the Indian context.
* Policy Development: Develop, review, and update local clinical policies and protocols to ensure full compliance with Indian mental health regulations (e.g., Mental Healthcare Act 2017\), ethical guidelines, and best practices.
* Quality Oversight: Design and oversee robust quality assurance activities, including systematic clinical audits, in\-depth case reviews, and continuous outcome monitoring (CORE\-10/Work Impact).
* Incident Management: Lead investigations into serious clinical incidents and formal complaints, collaborating with stakeholders to ensure corrective actions and systemic learning.
* Senior Escalation: Act as the final clinical escalation point for complex queries, ethical dilemmas, and high\-risk situations, providing expert guidance and resolution.
* Clinical Delivery Oversight \& Team Management
* Team Leadership: Provide senior clinical oversight and leadership to teams responsible for direct service delivery, including Intake Counselors, Clinical Case Managers, and Structured Counselors.
* Fidelity \& Pathways: Ensure consistent application of Lyra’s clinical pathways, standardized assessment tools, and evidence\-based intervention protocols across all delivery teams.
* Capacity Planning: Contribute to strategic planning regarding clinical team capacity and resource allocation to align with service demand and operational efficiency.
* Professional Development: Oversee onboarding and continuous professional development programs, focusing on clinical fidelity and the sophisticated use of Lyra’s methodologies.
* Mentorship: Foster a high\-performance environment by providing direct mentorship and supervision to Clinical Team Leaders.
* Case Management Excellence
* Clinical Integrity: Maintain overall responsibility for the clinical integrity and effectiveness of the case management function.
* Data\-Driven Optimization: Analyze aggregate case management data and trends to identify areas for process refinement and improved client outcomes.
* High\-Acuity Consultation: Provide direct clinical guidance on high\-acuity or highly sensitive cases requiring senior\-level review and intervention.
* Care Coordination: Ensure rigorous adherence to best practices in care coordination, inter\-provider collaboration, and referral pathways across the service spectrum.
* Interdepartmental Collaboration \& Strategic Input
* Network Partnership: Partner with the Network Operations Manager to ensure the provider network aligns with Lyra’s standards, providing clinical input on recruitment criteria and performance expectations.
* Strategic Advisory: Provide essential clinical expertise to Product Development, Commercial, and Client Success teams to inform service evolution and market strategy.
* Thought Leadership: Represent Lyra’s clinical approach and quality standards in external forums, conferences, and industry discussions.


**Requirements And Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in a clinical field (e.g., Clinical Psychology, Counseling, Social Work).
* Optional: Valid and current professional registration/licensure to practice independently in India (e.g., RCI registration for Clinical Psychologists or equivalent recognized national bodies).


**Experience**
* Several years of extensive post\-qualification clinical experience in mental health, including direct assessment, diagnosis, and evidence\-based interventions.
* Several years of progressive experience in a clinical leadership, supervisory, or programmatic oversight role within India.
* Deep understanding of the Indian mental healthcare landscape and regulatory compliance.
* Fluency in English and Hindi is essential; knowledge of other major regional languages is a significant advantage.


**About You**
* Clinical Acumen: Exceptional clinical understanding and the advanced ability to identify, assess, and manage high\-level clinical risk and complex psychological presentations.
* Problem Solver: Highly analytical with superior problem\-solving skills, capable of navigating intricate clinical and operational challenges independently.
* Autonomous \& Accountable: Able to work independently without close supervision, while ensuring all key issues are escalated appropriately and critical decisions are clinically sound.
* Detail\-Oriented: Meticulous attention to detail, ensuring accuracy of data, maintaining strict confidentiality, and adhering to complex clinical procedures.
* Communicator: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex clinical concepts clearly and professionally to diverse stakeholders internationally.
* Proactive \& Adaptive: Strong continuous improvement mindset, always seeking opportunities to innovate and refine clinical processes. Flexible, adaptable, and thrives in a fast\-paced environment.
* Organized: Highly organized with exceptional ability to plan, prioritize, and manage a high\-volume, complex clinical function effectively.
* Collaborative: A strong team player who readily accepts change and collaborates effectively with internal and external partners.


**Miscellaneous**
* Upholding Lyra Values: Act as a brand ambassador by consistently demonstrating Lyra’s core values of clinical excellence, innovation, and empathy.
* Task Ownership: Ensure all allotted clinical and administrative tasks are performed with high precision and within agreed\-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Process Optimization: Proactively identify gaps in current workflows and implement solutions that enhance operational efficiency and care outcomes.
* Workshop \& Content: Lead the delivery of onsite or online workshops and contribute to the development of training manuals and affiliate\-facing materials.
* Event Participation: Represent Lyra Health at professional events and webinars to promote Lyra’s transformative care model and clinical research.

We have a broad range of capabilities to assist clients with risk management, funding and capital management, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting and other financial analytics, Treasury technology, post\-merger integration, organizational design, cash management, and finance transformation.
   

  

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You’re likely to balance your time between personally executing client engagements, developing our business and processes, and managing a varied pipeline. That will mean working on new projects, as well as extensions for existing products, so you’ll be actively influencing a range of client relationships. We’ll also look to you to coach, support, and manage internal resources and demonstrate professionalism while working in the client environment. You will be expected to provide supervision and mentoring to staff and serve as point person for technical questions. It’s a strategic role in a rapidly growing area, where you’ll use your treasury and corporate finance knowledge and experience, as well as your understanding of our products, services and colleagues to further expand our market share, expand our solution capability, and deliver exemplary execution on client engagements. Specific responsibilities would include, but not be limited to:
   

  

* Lead and manage Treasury engagements as a senior team member to include project and resource planning, budget management, execution of work plans and client relationship management and ensure products/deliverables meet contract/work plan specifications and deadlines
* Lead the proposal development process and participate in pursuit team for prospective treasury engagements, support and lead business development and practice development initiatives
* Maintain a strong client focus by being responsive to client requests and developing/maintaining productive working relationships with client personnel.
* Collaborate with the partner and client to determine a strategy that appropriately addresses risk and manages client expectations relating to deliverables, understanding the client’s industry, key performance drivers, business trends and industry developments
* Develop and maintain strong networks, both internally and externally, and work with other service lines in providing an integrated service delivery
* Support the development of expanded client solutions in data and analysis, leveraging emerging technology and advanced analytics to deliver key insights to clients


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Handling the proposal development process for prospective treasury engagement, while supporting in the development of new services and strategies
* Supporting engagement planning, budgeting, execution and management
* Creating process flows and design documents, workshops and tools
* Overseeing end\-user training and support
* Building long\-term relationships with our clients to discover their unique goals, ambitions and needs
* Maintaining an up\-to\-date understanding of tools, practices, and trends in a wide range of areas, including in\-house cash, bank structure, communications, account G/L structure, intercompany processes, liquidity planning and payments processing. Strong analytical and technical skills
* Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* Achieved, or be working towards a professional designation, such as CTP, CFA, CPA, FRM
* A proven record of problem solving and analytical thinking within a global corporate treasury or consulting business
* Advanced skills and experience with: Treasury organizational structure and transformation, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting, analytics, liquidity management, cash and bank relationship management, international treasury centers, debt and investment management, due diligence, governance and controls, carve outs, and hedge accounting
* The confidence to train and mentor junior colleagues, providing the knowledge, skills and opportunities they need to excel
* Excellent sales and influencing skills, and the ability to present credibly to senior clients and colleagues
* Valid passport required; willingness and ability to travel internationally
* The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary
* Access to reliable transportation to/from the EY office and client sites. A driver’s license is strongly recommended as ride share and public transportation options may not be available in all locations


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A master’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, financial engineering, economics, information technology, information systems, engineering or another relevant discipline
* Certified Treasury Professional qualification
* CFA designation (or CFA candidate)
* Consulting experience on complex projects
* System selection and implementation experience


**What We Look For**
 We’re interested in natural problem\-solvers and leaders, with proven project management and engagement experience. You’ll have the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements, as well as the ability to communicate complex information simply and effectively to audiences from all backgrounds. If you’re a global treasury professional looking to further your career as part of a highly collaborative team, this role is for you.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.
   

  

* We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
* 
+ New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $154,000 to $256,700
+ Bay Area California offices – $160,500 to $267,400
+ All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $128,400 to $235,300

* Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
* Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.


**Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.**

title: Change Manager (IT)
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Change Manager (IT)
 
  
 



**Location:** 
 India, Mumbai
 



  
 



 The Agfa\-Gevaert Group develops, manufactures and distributes an extensive range of analogue and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications. Although the company generates its entire turnover in business\-to\-business markets, it also contributes to everyday life around the world. Whenever you read a newspaper or visit a hospital, Agfa technology is often involved behind the scenes. Agfa strives to be the partner of choice for imaging and information systems by combining innovative technology, deep industry expertise, and a strong commitment to quality and sustainability. Agfa’s headquarters are located in Mortsel, Belgium.
 


  About the Role
 
 Agfa is seeking a highly motivated and organized
 **Change Manager** 
 to join its Global IT (Information \& Communication Systems) organization. In this role, you will be responsible for governing and coordinating changes across Agfa's global IT landscape, ensuring that modifications to infrastructure, applications, platforms, and services are implemented in a controlled and efficient manner.
 



 You will play a critical role in minimizing business risk and service disruption while maximizing the success rate of IT changes. Working closely with internal stakeholders, managed service providers, and external vendors, you will ensure alignment, compliance, and operational excellence across the change management process.
 


  About You (Skills Required)
 
 You are a strong communicator and coordinator who thrives in a dynamic IT environment. You can balance governance and operational needs while effectively managing multiple stakeholders across different teams and vendors.
 



 You possess:
 


* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Excellent planning, coordination, and organizational capabilities.
* Analytical thinking with a structured approach to risk assessment and problem solving.
* The ability to work effectively across diverse teams, cultures, and external service providers.
* A continuous improvement mindset and focus on service quality.


* Flexibility and willingness to work outside standard business hours to support the planning, coordination, implementation, and governance of critical IT changes in a global 24/7 environment.



  
 



  
 


 What You'll Do (Duties \& Responsibilities)
 * Own and continuously improve the global IT Change Management process.
* Assess, classify, and evaluate changes, including risk and business impact analysis.
* Coordinate and manage changes across multiple vendors and managed service providers.
* Lead Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings and facilitate approval processes, including emergency change procedures.
* Maintain and communicate the 12\-month rolling maintenance calendar.
* Plan, schedule, and coordinate changes across infrastructure, applications, and services.
* Monitor change performance, reporting metrics, and SLA compliance.
* Conduct post\-implementation reviews and drive continuous process improvement initiatives.
* Manage stakeholder communications and change\-related escalations.
* Act as backup for Configuration Management activities when required.


  What You'll Bring (Experience \& Qualifications)
 * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience in IT Service Management or IT Operations environments.
* Strong understanding of Change Management principles and best practices.
* Experience working in outsourced IT environments and managing third\-party service providers.
* Technical background with a solid understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and application environments.
* Experience with ITIL processes and service management frameworks is highly desirable.
* Ability to work effectively in a global organization with geographically distributed teams.
* Relevant certifications such as ITIL Foundation or ITIL Managing Professional are considered an asset.



  
 



**Why Join Us** 



* Work in a global, multicultural, and collaborative team environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to a digital transformation initiatives.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Long\-term learning and career development opportunities.
* Be part of a global IT organization that enables innovation and business success across Agfa worldwide.
* Collaborate with international experts and strategic technology partners.
* Influence and improve key IT governance processes with global impact.



  
 



 If you are passionate about IT Service Management, governance, and driving operational excellence in a global environment, we would love to hear from you. Join Agfa and help shape the future of our global IT services.

The role will drive partner performance, customer satisfaction, service excellence, operational governance, commercial management, and strategic partner development while ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and customer promises.

**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\.
 **Service Partner Strategy \& Governance** 



* Define and execute the national partner management strategy aligned with business, customer experience, and operational objectives.
* Govern the end\-to\-end partner ecosystem, including authorized service centers, logistics partners, installation partners, repair partners, and specialized service providers.
* Establish governance frameworks, review forums, performance scorecards, and escalation mechanisms to drive accountability and continuous improvement.
* Drive strategic partner development initiatives to support future business growth and service transformation.

* Lead end\-to\-end service delivery through partner networks, ensuring achievement of customer experience and service delivery objectives.

* Drive service recovery mechanisms and ensure timely resolution of customer escalations.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and implement corrective action plans in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.



 3\.
 **Partner Performance Management** 



* Establish performance measurement frameworks for all service partners.
* Monitor adherence to contractual commitments, KPIs, SLAs, compliance requirements, and operating standards.
* Conduct periodic business reviews and performance audits.
* Design improvement plans to enhance service quality, productivity, turnaround time, first\-time resolution, and customer satisfaction.



 4\.
 **Partner Selection, RFP \& Onboarding** 



* Lead the complete partner evaluation and onboarding lifecycle.
* Define partner assessment criteria covering operational capability, service coverage, compliance, technology readiness, commercial viability, and customer service capability.
* Manage RFP processes, partner selection, commercial assessments, due diligence, and contract recommendations.
* Ensure successful onboarding and integration of partners into Croma's service ecosystem.



 5\.
 **Commercial \& Financial Management** 



* Manage partner commercials, rate cards, payment governance, penalties, incentives, and financial reconciliations.
* Collaborate with Finance and Procurement teams to ensure commercial compliance and budget adherence.
* Drive productivity and cost optimization initiatives without compromising customer experience.
* Monitor partner billing accuracy, contract obligations, and financial performance.



 6\.
 **Capacity Planning \& Operational Readiness** 



* Ensure adequate partner capacity, manpower deployment, technician availability, and infrastructure readiness across locations.
* Drive demand forecasting and resource planning to support seasonal peaks, business growth, and new service launches.
* Monitor operational readiness and service continuity across all partner locations.



 7\.
 **Continuous Improvement \& Transformation** 



* Lead all service improvement programs across partner operations.
* Identify gaps through customer feedback, VOC, audits, operational reviews, complaint analysis, and partner scorecards.
* Drive process standardization, automation, digitization, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Lead implementation of new operating models, policies, technologies, and customer service processes.



 8\.
 **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Stores Operations, Technology, Product, Finance, Marketing, Buying, Supply Chain, HR, Training, and Customer Experience teams.
* Support design and deployment of customer service journeys for new products, services, subscription plans, and service propositions.
* Ensure operational alignment across all stakeholders impacting customer experience.



 9\.
 **Risk, Compliance \& Control** 



* Identify and mitigate operational, financial, compliance, partner, and customer experience risks.
* Ensure adherence to organizational policies, statutory requirements, audit controls, and service governance frameworks.
* Drive corrective actions arising from audits and compliance reviews.
* Develop business continuity plans for partner operations.
* Drive a culture of accountability, customer centricity, ownership, and continuous improvement.



  





**Education** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Management, Operations, Customer Service, or related discipline.

**Experience**

title: Change Manager
description:
Experience : 8\+ Years
 



 Location : Mumbai
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced Technical Change Manager to support a large\-scale Salesforce Revenue Cloud implementation. This role will be part of the PMO and will be responsible for coordinating technical changes, release activities, business approvals, deployment readiness, and production releases.
 



 The ideal candidate will have strong experience managing enterprise application releases, coordinating across business and technology teams, obtaining required sign\-offs, and driving Go/No\-Go decisions for production deployments.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 • Own the Change Management and Release Management process for the Salesforce Revenue Cloud program.
 



 • Work as part of the PMO, coordinating closely with Program Managers, Business Leads, Salesforce teams, QA, DevOps, Support, and other technology teams.
 



 • Coordinate and track all technical changes associated with Salesforce releases.
 



 • Ensure appropriate business approvals and sign\-offs are obtained before production deployment.
 



 • Maintain release plans, deployment schedules, change calendars, dependencies, and readiness checkpoints.
 



 • Coordinate release activities across Development, QA, UAT, Production, and supporting systems.
 



 • Validate that required testing, UAT approvals, production readiness, rollback plans, and support plans are completed before release.
 



 • Lead Go/No\-Go calls and facilitate release readiness discussions with business and technology stakeholders.
 



 • Document decisions, risks, issues, dependencies, and action items from Go/No\-Go meetings.
 



 • Coordinate production deployment activities and ensure all participating teams understand their responsibilities and timelines.
 



 • Manage emergency changes, planned releases, hot fixes, and production change requests.
 



 • Coordinate releases involving Salesforce and integrated upstream/downstream enterprise applications.
 



 • Track release risks and escalate issues that could impact deployment timelines or business operations.
 



 • Ensure changes follow established Change Management, Release Management, and governance processes.
 



 • Coordinate post\-deployment validation, production verification, and business confirmation.
 



 • Facilitate post\-release reviews and capture lessons learned for future releases.
 



 • Provide release and change status reporting to PMO and senior stakeholders.
 



 Required Skills \& Experience
 



 • 7\+ years of experience in Technical Change Management, Release Management, Program Management, or Technical PMO roles.
 



 • Strong experience managing enterprise application releases and production deployments.
 



 • Experience supporting Salesforce implementations, preferably Salesforce Revenue Cloud, CPQ, Billing, or Quote\-to\-Cash programs.
 



 • Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, testing, UAT, production deployment, and release governance.
 



 • Experience running Go/No\-Go meetings and production readiness reviews.
 



 • Strong experience obtaining and managing business, technology, QA, and operational sign\-offs.
 



 • Ability to coordinate multiple technical and business teams across complex releases.
 



 • Experience managing release calendars, dependencies, risks, issues, and deployment checklists.
 



 • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
 



 • Experience working within a PMO governance structure.
 



 • Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Salesforce DevOps tools, or similar platforms.
 



  





**Preferred Experience:** 




 • Salesforce Revenue Cloud / Revenue Cloud Advanced
 



 • Salesforce CPQ and Billing
 



 • Quote\-to\-Cash / Lead\-to\-Cash processes
 



 • Salesforce integrations with ERP, Finance, Billing, CRM, and downstream systems
 



 • ITIL Change and Release Management
 



 • CI/CD and Salesforce deployment processes
 



 • Large enterprise transformation programs
 



  





**Key Focus Areas:** 




 This is not a traditional Organizational Change Management / communications role. The primary focus is technical change governance, release coordination, production readiness, business sign\-offs, and execution of enterprise Salesforce releases.
 



 The Technical Change Manager will serve as the central coordination point between the PMO, Business, Salesforce delivery teams, QA, DevOps, and Production Support to ensure every release is properly approved, controlled, communicated, and successfully deployed.

This role is part of the Project Controls Team within the Centre of Excellence (COE) team and aligns deliverables to project requirements, regional codes and standards, and ensures independent cost verification. The associate contributes to process standardization and governance initiatives to improve commercial efficiencies within real estate projects, particularly office fit\-outs.
   

  

**Role accountabilities:**
* Integrated Project Controls: Collaborate with Project Controls team members to align Capital Management deliverables and timelines, ensuring strict adherence to the policies and procedures of each Stage Gate process.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Finance, Procurement, and Risk teams to support procurement strategies, P\&L management, and independent cost verification across key project milestones.
* MEP Deliverable Management: Support the preparation of MEP\-specific deliverables—including cost estimates, change order assessments, and cost reports—ensuring alignment with regional codes, standards, and project requirements.
* Commercial Monitoring \& Reporting: Assist the Project Controls Manager in reviewing MEP design information against approved Business Cases to identify budget gaps and support quarterly/annual capital planning exercises.
* Process Optimization \& Standardization: Drive global process standardization and quality assurance initiatives to improve governance, commercial efficiency, and the implementation of standard COE tools and templates.
* Market Intelligence \& Strategic Awareness: Monitor construction industry trends, including MEP technologies and economic indices (inflation/commodity prices), to assess their impact on capital projects and design stages (RIBA).
* Operational Excellence \& Team Leadership: Proactively escalate operational issues, participate in continuous improvement programs, and provide regular performance updates to leadership to foster an innovative and efficient team culture.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical /Electrical Engineering, Quantity Surveying.
* 5 to 6 years of experience in delivering MEP cost management, quantity surveying services for Real Estate projects (Office fit\-outs, Investment Banking and Financial Institutions experience preferable),
* Good understanding of pre\-contract (quantification \& market analysis supporting cost planning, benchmarking, design validation, risk management) and post\-contract (rate analysis \& drawings measurements supporting change control management, cost reporting, final accounts) stages of MEP services of Real Estate projects.
* Experience working in a global organization or COE or PMO (prior experience of working on Owner’s side is preferable).
* Awareness about construction/engineering practices, trends and cost indices.
* Experience of working with stakeholders and teams spread across 2\-3 regions.

description:
Job Profile: Senior Manager, Cyber Risk Consulting, Marsh Risk Consulting UK
   

  

 Location: Mumbai

**Marsh** 
 is a global leader in insurance broking and risk management. In more than 130 countries, our experts in every facet of risk and across industries help clients to anticipate, quantify, and more fully understand the range of risks they face.
   

  

**Marsh Advisory** 
 is the consultative branch of Marsh, which operates internationally and provides solutions in the increasing needs of our clients to implement risk management programs within their organization. Marsh Advisory helps companies to change their risk profiles so they can improve resiliency, reduce claims, and minimize the total cost of risk. Businesses today regularly tackle multiple challenges, whether facing property and casualty, cyber, reputation, or other risks, Marsh Advisory can help.
   

  

 The global
 **Cyber Risk Consulting** 
 (CRC) practice of Marsh Advisory supports customers to understand, estimate and mitigate cyber risks. This role is open in Marsh McLennan India Private Limited (MMIPL) a global in\-house center for Marsh. The MMIPL in Mumbai has a function called ‘Knowledge Services which supports the MMC group by providing specialized services. Under the Knowledge Services function, there is Marsh Advisory team, which supports the global clients and colleagues. This role will initiate a new service line for Marsh Advisory team in Mumbai, which entails supporting the CRC colleagues in execution of the cyber consulting projects.
   

  

**What can you expect?**
* You will join an international team of cyber security experts helping our clients with all aspects of their cyber security programs and contributing toward their business resilience.
* You will be flexible and ready to adapt to a constantly changing environment, sharing your time between reviewing and developing cyber strategies and products, managing consulting projects, advising stakeholders, leading workshops, as well as supporting business development and marketing.
* Immediate exposure to top\-tier clients and excellent opportunities for personal and professional development.
* Since you will be working directly with clients, some travel will be required.


**We will count on you to:**
* Support business development of Cyber Risk Consulting UK Region.
* Support the design and delivery of multiple Cyber Risk Consulting projects through to their timely completion as required.
* Collaborate across the Marsh (global and regional) community and provide expert input and contributions where necessary.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with other involved parties such as Marsh cyber brokerage colleagues, global cyber teams and business partners.


**What you need to have \[Required Skills and Experience]:**
* Graduate degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
* 6 to 8 years professional experience in the cybersecurity field.
* Demonstrable understanding of technology and security principles and deep knowledge of cyber threat landscape.
* Good understanding of IT architectures, networks, common business applications, SaaS services and data storage.
* Understanding network security principles, including firewalls, VPNs, and secure network architecture.
* Familiarity with cloud security, endpoint security, and network security best practices.
* Good understanding of UK and European cybersecurity regulations and standards, such as: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Network and Information Systems (NIS) Directive, EU Cybersecurity Act, European Union Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA) guidelines, DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act) for financial institutions.
* Good knowledge of cybersecurity compliance standards and frameworks, including ISO 27001, NIST, and CIS Controls.
* Analytical problem\-solving skills and experience ideally gained in the management\-consulting sector although other sectors could be relevant.
* Experience in supporting multiple projects from inception to completion with high quality of delivery in a complex and challenging environment.
* Smart, collaborative, strong sense of business ethics and principles
* Ability to demonstrate sound judgment in the prioritization of competing work assignments, escalation of issues and the formulation of solutions.
* Effective organization skills with key attention to detail and delivery of high\-quality documentation with the ability to implement/influence change.
* Professional security certifications (CISA, CISM, CISSP) would be advantageous.
* Experience and skills acquired in Incident Response is advantageous.
* Experience in Vulnerability Assessment, Penetration Testing techniques and tools is advantageous.
* Excellent English language skills (both verbal and written) and the ability to communicate technical matters to a non\-technical audience.

description:
**Role Summary**
 Do you want to make a global impact on patient health? Pfizer's International Commercial division is transforming how we bring our medicines to patients across international markets. Within Business Transformation \& Technology, our Data Engineering and AI organization builds and scales AI\-powered products for internal commercial clients — solutions that sharpen decision\-making, accelerate execution, and free our teams to focus on what matters most: ensuring patients receive the medicines they need.
   

  

 As a
 **Senior Manager, AI Solutions Tech Lead** 
 , you will be the hands\-on technical leader for AI products across our International portfolio — orchestrating the build across blended teams of internal engineers and external contractors while staying close to the code. You will bring deep expertise in at least one core discipline — data engineering, data science and ML engineering, AI engineering, or backend/full\-stack development — combined with working knowledge across the others, and you will navigate the full digital solution stack with confidence: data products, AI data products, generative and agentic AI solutions, and full\-stack applications, understanding what it takes to advance each from POC to MVP to an enterprise\-grade system. You will set and enforce engineering standards, drive technical decision\-making through structured trade\-off analysis and well\-reasoned proposals, and safeguard the quality of everything the team ships — reviewing pull requests and contributing features alongside your leadership responsibilities.
   

  

**Role Responsibilities**
* Act as the hands\-on tech lead for AI product delivery: orchestrate the build across blended teams of 10\+ internal engineers and external contractors, while remaining hands\-on through pull request reviews and targeted feature development.

* Operate fluently across the digital solution stack — data products, AI data products, generative/agentic AI solutions, and full\-stack applications — and guide the team on sound implementation choices for each.
* Coordinate and manage delivery through external vendor and contractor teams alongside internal engineering resources, with emphasis on the quality of deliverables and adherence to team standards.
* Collaborate extensively with product owners, core engineering and data science teams, leadership stakeholders, and contractors; communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and approaches (including agentic AI); evaluate their applicability and foster a collaborative learning environment within the team.


**Qualifications**
**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline (Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field) and 7\+ years of hands\-on experience in AI, data, or software solution engineering, with a track record of building, deploying, and testing complex software systems.
* Demonstrated technical leadership experience as a tech lead or equivalent, orchestrating teams of 10\+ members, including blended internal and contractor teams.
* Experience coordinating with and managing external vendor or contractor teams, with emphasis on delivery quality.
* Deep expertise in at least one relevant discipline (e.g., data engineering, data science and ML engineering, AI engineering, backend/full\-stack development), with working exposure across the others.
* Solid understanding of the digital product development lifecycle, including the distinction between POC, MVP, and enterprise\-grade systems and the engineering practices each stage requires.
* Strong critical thinking, technical judgment, and trade\-off analysis; ability to formulate proposals, analyses, and decision rationale.
* Fluency in Python and proficiency in SQL; ability to write clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
* Experience working in a cloud\-based analytics ecosystem (e.g., AWS, Snowflake) and familiarity with modern data tooling (e.g., Airflow, dbt) and the standard AI engineering stack.
* Solid grounding in cloud infrastructure and backend engineering, CI/CD, and testing practices; awareness of MLOps/LLMOps.
* Hands\-on experience working in agile teams, processes, and practices, and proficiency with agile delivery tooling (e.g., Jira, Confluence).

* Demonstrated willingness and flexibility to learn new technologies and approaches; an exploratory mindset.

* Advanced degree in a relevant discipline.
* Experience building generative and agentic AI solutions (e.g., orchestrating agents on top of existing services and front ends).

title: Assistant Manager - Client Solutions
description:
**About Nextyn:** 




 Nextyn is a fast\-growing expert network company that enables clients worldwide to connect with industry experts for research, consulting, and strategic decision\-making.
 



 With a growing global presence, we work with clients across geographies and industries, helping them access high\-quality expert insights to support critical business and investment decisions.
 



 Role Summary
 



  





 As an
 **Assistant Manager – Client Solutions** 
 , you will manage key client relationships while leading a team of Associates/Analysts responsible for delivering high\-quality expert research and engagement.
 



  





 The role combines
 **client relationship management, team leadership, expert identification, project delivery, and account growth** 
 . You will be responsible for understanding client requirements, ensuring timely and high\-quality execution, developing your team, and identifying opportunities to strengthen and grow client accounts.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Client Relationship Management
 


* Own end\-to\-end relationships with a portfolio of key clients and understand their research objectives, priorities, and evolving requirements.
* Act as the primary point of contact for client queries, escalations, and project\-related discussions.
* Build strong, long\-term relationships that support client retention and account growth.
* Maintain a high level of responsiveness and ensure a consistent client experience across engagements.



 2\. Team Management \& Development
 


* Recruit, onboard, train, and develop Associates/Analysts within the Client Solutions team.
* Set clear goals and expectations and monitor individual and team performance.
* Provide regular coaching, feedback, and support to help team members build their client management, research, and expert engagement capabilities.
* Build a high\-performing team that can independently manage projects and deliver against client expectations.



 3\. Expert Identification \& Engagement
 


* Oversee the identification, evaluation, and engagement of relevant industry experts for client requirements.
* Guide the team on expert sourcing strategies and quality evaluation criteria.
* Ensure experts identified are relevant, credible, and aligned with the client's research objectives.
* Take ownership of specialized, complex, or high\-priority expert searches when required.



 4\. Account Growth \& Revenue
 


* Own revenue targets for assigned accounts and work towards achieving account growth objectives.
* Identify opportunities for upselling, cross\-selling, and expanding relationships across client accounts.
* Track account performance and proactively highlight potential risks and growth opportunities to leadership.
* Support client proposals, pricing discussions, and commercial conversations where required.



 5\. Project Coordination \& Delivery
 


* Oversee the timely and high\-quality execution of projects managed by the team.
* Coordinate with internal teams including Research, Operations, and Compliance to resolve project\-related bottlenecks.
* Monitor turnaround times, project progress, and quality standards across active engagements.
* Step in where required to resolve critical issues and ensure client commitments are met.



 6\. Research \& Insights
 


* Guide the team on qualitative and quantitative research approaches based on client requirements.
* Review and validate research outputs, expert profiles, and market insights before client delivery.
* Develop a strong understanding of relevant industries and market trends to support client conversations and internal decision\-making.
* Use research and market insights to identify relevant experts and strengthen project outcomes.



  





 Qualifications \& Skills
 



 Education
 


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Management, or a related field.



  





 Experience
 


* 2–5 years of relevant experience in expert networks, client management, account management, research, consulting, or a similar client\-facing environment.
* Prior experience managing or mentoring a team is preferred.
* Experience in expert networks, market research, consulting, or professional services will be an advantage.



  





 Skills
 


* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong client and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proven ability to manage, coach, and develop a team.
* Strong analytical, research, and problem\-solving skills.
* Good business judgment and the ability to understand client requirements.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts, projects, and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, and ability to work effectively under deadlines.



  





 Location \& Joining
 


* **Location:** 
 Mumbai
* **Work Model:** 
 Work from Office
* **Preference:** 
 Immediate joiners preferred



  





 What Nextyn Offers
 


* Work\-from\-office environment with structured working hours.
* Opportunity to work with global clients and senior industry experts.
* Leadership exposure through team management and account ownership.
* Opportunities to build expertise across industries and develop strong client\-facing capabilities.
* Learning and career growth opportunities within a rapidly scaling organization.
* Competitive compensation and benefits, including PF and insurance.

title: Regulatory Reporting_Director_Core Sevices
description:
We’re seeking someone to join our team as a
 **Director\- Independent Testing** 
 in Ops Risk and Regulatory Control to lead regulatory assurance activities across Morgan Stanley's global transaction reporting framework. This role is responsible for overseeing risk\-based testing programmes, identifying regulatory reporting risks, driving remediation of control weaknesses, and providing independent assurance over the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of transaction reporting across multiple global regimes.
   

  

 In the Operations division, we partner with business units across the Firm to support financial transactions, devise and implement effective controls and develop client relationships. This is a Team Supervisor position at Director level within the within Core Services, which is responsible for performing and managing product\-agnostic and centralized operational services across several businesses and products.
   

  

 Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
   

  

**What You'll Do In The Role**
* Lead global Independent Testing programmes covering transaction reporting regulations across multiple jurisdictions.
* Provide oversight of cyclical, diagnostic, thematic, and data\-driven testing activities.
* Drive identification, escalation, governance, and remediation of regulatory reporting issues and control gaps.
* Partner with senior stakeholders to deliver regulatory change, control enhancements, and strategic initiatives.
* Champion automation, data analytics, AI, and process improvement opportunities to enhance testing effectiveness.
* Lead, coach, and develop a global team while fostering a strong culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as the primary supervisor within specific line or project area with accountability to associated risks.
* Manage direct reports, leading 1:1s and career development, attracting and retaining high quality talent in line with our leadership commitments.
* Review resources to ensure adequate coverage to deliver BAU commitments, highlighting current and future needs to manager.
* Share expert knowledge across the team, contributing to team output and ensuring diverse viewpoints are heard.


**What You'll Bring To The Role**
* Extensive experience in Regulatory Reporting, Independent Testing, Compliance, Risk, Audit, or Control functions.
* Strong knowledge of transaction reporting regulations such as MiFID II, EMIR, SFTR, CAT, CFTC, SEC, CSA, HKMA, MAS, JFSA, ASIC, and BOI.
* Proven leadership experience managing global teams and influencing senior stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, governance, and issue management skills.
* Experience leveraging data analytics, automation, AI, Power BI, Alteryx, or similar technologies to drive operational excellence.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and strategic thinking capabilities.
* Ability to lead by example, work with drive and determination, adapt management style to suit individuals and ensure team is well supported with a sense of purpose.
* Prepared to challenge the status quo, raise concerns and/or needs of their team members.
* Ability to pitch communication appropriately according to the audience and demonstrate active listening skills.
* Culture carrier across Operations, embracing the Firm's core values and acting as a role model.
* At least 6 years' relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role


**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
   

  

 To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
   

  

 Our workforce reflects a broad cross\-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
   

  

 For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people\-opportunities/eeo.

title: Senior Associate, Operational Risk Manager, Consumer Banking Group
description:
A person in this role will own (design, implement, improve, monitor and steer other teams \& vendors) the overall governance \& controls framework across all products, channels and services of Consumer bank.
   

  

 This person will ensure internal and pertinent local/ global regulatory guidelines are implemented or reports are done in time and with the desired quality. As a gatekeeper for all regulations and controls, this person will ensure the identification of operational risks, periodic awareness and management accordingly.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
 Act as the CBG Operations Risk Manager with below key responsibilities
   

  

* Enhance CBG India's risk governance framework by actively facilitating internal committees and ensuring robust representation in bank\-wide governance forums.
* Develop \& ensure effective recommendation of all operational risk policies, standards, and guidelines, both at the corporate and unit\-specific levels.
* Rigorous oversight and highlight all deviations from corporate operational risk policies, upholding stringent control standards.
* Strategically coordinate all audit and regulatory inspections to ensure seamless collaboration and compliance with the requirements.
* Ensure flawless and timely reporting of operational risk events including analyzing and reporting operational risk events, loss trends and root cause to Team lead and relevant risk and control committees by adhering strictly to Group standards for completeness and accuracy,
* Review and provide advisory guidance on the efficacy and appropriateness of risk mitigating measures and plans.


**Actively monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs)** 
 to identify and address emerging risks and maintain a robust risk posture.
   

  

**Job Duties \& responsibilities** 
 (List the principal duties. Use concise statements that provide a clear understanding of the level of responsibility, complexity, creativity and analysis performed in this position.)
   

  

**Risk and Control Self\-Assessment**
* Identify/update the scope of RCSA to be completed for CBG India.
* Plan and implement the RCSA program across all areas within CBG
* Identifying and assessing inherent/net/residual risks and aligned internal controls with timely review / testing.
* Validate RCSA against actual risk event losses, KRI trends, audit and regulatory inspections


**Governance of Partnership tie\-up**
* Support UROM in facilitating the Outsourcing Risk Review with the control teams including ISS, Operations, Technology, Audit, GPS, Risk, Legal and Compliance
* Facilitate the assessment process required for Outsourced Service Providers with the Ecosystem partners and the control teams


**Product/ Process Risk reviews**
* Facilitate NPA review and approval process for CBG products within the Country and Regional stakeholders
* Support in review periodic Product releases \& Standard Operating procedures as and when needed and highlight controls to be built in
* Identification and running of theme\-based reviews of the processes from Controls perspective


**Business Risk Management**
* Identification of Legal and Compliance risks, mitigants and residual risks in co\-ordination with the business \& operations teams and facilitate the process of risk acceptance.
* Facilitate the business and operations team in establishing the risk framework for CBG and ensuring timely closures.


**Pro\-active audits to ensure the best possible audit rating**
* Liaise with the Audit team to establish a risk\-based audit approach for CBG
* Provide input for co\-ordination with the audit team for assessments pertaining to CBG \& close tracking on audit issues pertaining to CBG.


**Business Continuity Management**
* Ensure timely implementation of BCM policies and standards
* Ensure timely reporting/ escalation of incidents causing disruptions to the business
* Highlight key BCM issues to unit management and track action plans to closure


**Stakeholder \& talent management**
* Provide support during regulatory inspections to ensure data and responses provided are in line with requirements


 Constant compliance to laid down training \& certification requirements and participate in creating culture of knowledge depth for self and within the team by regular input \& knowledge sharing \& upskilling.
   

  

**Required Experience**
* Minimum 4 to 8 years’ experience in banking, especially related to operational risk management \& business risk controls

 Professional qualifications on projects and change management are desirable but not mandatory.
   

  

**Core Competencies**
* Understanding of country regulations specifically in consumer/ retail banking space
* Understanding of digital lending processes \& Basic AI use

* Analyze and monitor the KRI data highlight KRI trends and issues


**Technical Competencies**
* Data Analysis: Proficiency in analyzing data to identify trends, patterns, and potential risks

title: Vice President Supply Chain
description:
To oversees the efficient flow of goods, information, and finances from raw material procurement to final product delivery while coordinating with suppliers, manufacturing plant and distributors to meet customer demands
 



  Supply Chain Manager: Oversee the entire supply chain, develop strategies to optimize efficiency, manage budgets, and coordinate with various stakeholders.
 



  Procurement Specialist: Should have understanding and experience of sourcing and purchase raw materials, negotiate with suppliers, manage contracts, and ensure cost\-effective procurement. Build strategic suppliers for packing material. Understand the various activities and implications of imports and fulfilment of advance licenses.
 



  Logistics Coordinator: Manage transportation, warehousing, and distribution of goods, ensure timely delivery, and optimize logistics costs.
 



  Inventory Management: Monitor inventory levels, forecast demand, manage stock replenishment, and minimize excess inventory of raw material, packing material and Finished Products.
 



  Demand Planner: Predict future product demand, create demand forecasts, and align supply chain activities with market needs. Identify minimum quantities of raw material and packing material to be kept so that economies of purchase and continuity of production can be maintained while balancing the working capital. Do ABC analysis of stocks.
 



  Product Launches \& Collaboration: Partner with business teams (R\&D, Production, Quality etc.) to support global product launches (in\-house and CMOs). Ensure timely delivery of final outputs within defined budgets and timelines.
 



  CMO: Build supplier base and Oversee procurement of CMO products at cost effective prices with continued high\-quality product supplies. Ensure quality compliance of CMO\-manufactured products through effective coordination with CMO partners, Quality Assurance, and cross\-functional teams.
 



  Cross functional activities – Plant and manufacturing coordination: Ensure seamless collaboration between Supply Chain, Production, and Quality functions to achieve timely dispatch of products while maintaining compliance and service levels. Understand the plant capacities and ensure the plant is running at optimum capacities.
 



  Risk Management: Identify potential risks and vulnerabilities in the supply chain such as supply shortages, supplier disruptions, regulatory changes and geopolitical issues. Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies to address challenges and business continuity.
 



  Technology and Innovation: Stay updated with the latest trends, technologies and innovations in supply chain management software, data analyst and automation.
 



  





**Competencies** 




  Hands\-on knowledge and exposure related to procurement, logistics, commercial of related materials in pharmaceutical formulations industry.
 



  Awareness on domestic/International pharma regulatory guidelines on Supply chain management.
 



  Knowledge and understanding of industry 4\.0 and its applicability in pharmaceutical industry.

title: Associate Program Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
 This role combines functional expertise in regulatory tax compliance with strong business analysis and operational leadership. The individual will act as a bridge between client stakeholders, product, and engineering teams, while also managing tax operations to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant deliverables.
   

  

 The role requires hands\-on involvement in requirement analysis, system validation, reporting accuracy, and operational oversight across compliance processes such as FATCA, CRS, and Chapter 3 withholding and reporting.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**Required skills and qualifications**
- Business Analysis and Delivery

- Requirements Gathering \& Documentation

* Conduct detailed requirement gathering sessions with client stakeholders and internal teams.
* Undertake system and functional impact, translate business requirements and regulatory tax rules/ updates (Chapter 3, FATCA, CRS) into structured documentation (BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, etc.).
* Produce use cases, data flow diagrams, process flow diagrams and sequence diagrams.
* Create and maintain documentation for specific client implementation/ integration, API, and product release notes.


- Developer and Tester Enablement

* Conduct walkthroughs with developers and testers to explain requirements, and regulatory logic in precise technical terms and in simple understandable ways.
* Actively participate in defect triage, root cause analysis, and resolution validation.


- Test Case Design \& Execution

* Create comprehensive test cases and test scripts covering functional, regression, edge\-case and negative scenarios.
* Work closely with QA teams to create/ clarify acceptance criteria.
* Lead and manage System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) end\-to\-end, including defect lifecycle management and sign\-off.


- Report Validation \& Compliance Review

* Validate system\-generated regulatory reports i.e. general compliance/ ad\-hoc report requests from clients and year\-end tax filing outputs (e.g., 1042\-S, 1099, 8805, 8966 FATCA, CRS).
* Review reporting logic, data mapping, and output accuracy against applicable regulatory schemas and filing standards.
* Validate the XML generated for FATCA and CRS for submission into the government portals and deliver to the client/ client’s auditors.
* Lead client data migration as part of the new client onboarding process.


- Leadership and Backup Coverage

* Act as a Project Manager / Technology Delivery Lead in the absence of the manager, ensuring continuity of delivery and decision\-making
* Coordinate with onshore/offshore teams, track progress, and manage priorities across workstreams
* Drive status updates, stakeholder communication, and issue escalation as needed


- Tax Operations Management

- Team Leadership and Oversight

* Manage the day\-to\-day operations of the Tax Ops team, providing clear direction, prioritisation, and escalation management.
* Assign tasks and allocate resources based on team capacity, skillsets, and urgency.


- Process Improvement and Automation

* Assess operational workflows to identify inefficiencies and areas for process improvement or automation.
* Partner with technology teams to scope and drive automation initiatives that reduce manual effort and improve accuracy.
* Document updated SOPs and train team members on revised processes.


- Guidance and Support

* Provide subject matter guidance to team members on new regulatory requirements, withholding obligations, and reporting (general or year\-end) activities.
* Act as the first point of contact for complex operational queries.
* Train new joiners.


- General Reporting and Year\-End Reporting Support

* Oversee operational readiness for reporting cycles and contribution/ delivery to year\-end regulatory reporting cycles.
* Provide hands\-on support for the preparation and review of year\-end tax reports, ensuring completeness and accuracy across all reportable populations.


- Product Subject Matter Expertise

- Deep System Knowledge

* Develop and maintain comprehensive, end\-to\-end knowledge of the tax compliance platform, including functional working, data ingestion, processing logic, and output generation.
* Serve as the internal SME and go\-to authority on system capabilities, limitations, configuration options, and known behaviours.


- Report \& Reporting Logic Mastery

* Maintain thorough working knowledge of all reports (general or regulatory year\-end reporting related) generated by the system\- their data sources (high level), business rules, transformation logic, and output formats.
* Identify and escalate discrepancies between expected regulatory output and actual system behaviour, partnering with development for resolution.
* Contribute to product roadmap discussions by providing informed feedback grounded in regulatory requirements and operational experience.
* Proven experience as a Senior Business Analyst in a software delivery or financial services environment. Candidates with a background in finance, tax, or accounting functions within a technology delivery context.
* Total experience of 13 years, with a minimum of 7/8 years in a Business Analyst role within a finance, banking, or tax\-technology environment.
* Mumbai location is preferred (primary).
* Hands\-on experience in SIT/UAT testing, test case creation, and defect management.
* Experience managing teams or leading operational workflows.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, particularly with data validation and reporting.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear functional specifications.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including working with large datasets, complex formulas, data validation, and reconciliation (e.g., lookups, pivot tables, conditional logic).
* Prior experience or exposure to FATCA, CRS, or Chapter 3 regulations is preferred.
* Experience with regulatory reporting (e.g., 1042\-S, 1099, CRS/FATCA submissions) is an added advantage.
* Candidates without prior tax regulatory experience but with strong analytical and functional skills are encouraged to apply; structured on\-the\-job training will be provided to build domain expertise.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, or a related field. Relevant professional certifications (e.g., CBAP, ICA, CIPP) are advantageous.


**About The Team**
 eClerx is a global leader in productized services, bringing together people, technology and domain expertise to amplify business results. Our mission is to set the benchmark for client service and success in our industry. Our vision is to be the innovation partner of choice for technology, data analytics and process management services. Since our inception in 2000, we've partnered with top companies across various industries, including financial services, telecommunications, retail, and high\-tech. title: Senior Program Manager
description:
Senior Manager \- Technical Diligence \& Project Controls \| Vantrock Real Assets \| Mumbai
 



  





 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
 



  





 Read a site badly at diligence and the error is baked into the underwriting for the life of the asset. Read it well and the deal either improves or dies early, the cheapest outcome available. The same scepticism, pointed at a contractor's programme, tells you whether the date on it is real. Pointed at a running bill, it tells you whether we are paying for work that exists.
 



  





 Vantrock currently buys all of that judgement from consultants, one assignment at a time, with nobody inside who can mark their work. The pipeline is 10 million sq ft and ground breaks on the first 2 million in January 2027\. From that point the platform is running acquisitions and construction at once, and whoever can walk a site in the morning and take apart a Primavera file in the afternoon becomes the most useful person in the room.
 



  





 This is the technical seat in the Enterprise Programme Management Office. The other two seats hold the portfolio and the governance. You hold the ground truth underneath both, and you hold it across the whole life of an asset rather than at one gate.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 




  





 Before we buy
 



 \- Technical pre\-diligence on every site under consideration. Ground, levels and cut\-fill, approach and access, power availability and distance to source, water, drainage and outfall, existing structures, and every physical constraint that changes what can be built there. Your output goes into the underwriting as a technical view with the assumptions stated.
 



 \- The buildability and cost\-shape read. Not a BOQ, a judgement: what makes this site expensive and where the foundation cost goes. Early, rough and honest beats late and precise.
 



 \- Development potential against the authority's rules. What MIDC, HSIIDC, KIADB or the local DCR actually permit on this parcel, and what that does to the yield the model assumes.
 



  





**While we design and build** 




 \- Design and specification review. Read what the architect and the consultants propose against what actually builds, and against the Vantrock specification, before it becomes a tender.
 



 \- Tender and rate scrutiny. Rate analysis, comparative statements and the technical read on a bid. You can look at a rate and say whether it is real.
 



 \- Programme review and claims. Take apart the contractor's and the PMC's programmes on critical path, float, sequencing and resource loading, and report what is real. Assess extension\-of\-time claims on their technical merits. A programme that has never been challenged is a wish.
 



 \- Technical validation on site. Running bills, measurement, quality and progress against the drawings. What you certify is technical. The money is finance's, and the two of you reconcile weekly.
 



  





**Through handover and after** 




 \- The technical close\-out. Snagging, defect liability, warranties and the as\-built record, so the asset arrives at operations in a state somebody can run.
 



 \- The occupier's technical requirements. Floor loading, flatness, power, fire and insurer conditions, read against what the building gives, so leasing and the tenant's fit\-out are not negotiating against a surprise.
 



 \- The physical record. Site visits captured properly and put into Vantrock Intelligence, so the platform's memory of a site does not live in one person's phone.
 



  





**Across all of it** 




 \- Command of technical partners. Geotechnical agencies, surveyors, TDD firms, third\-party inspection and PMCs. You brief them, hold them to a standard and mark their output. You never take a report on trust because it arrived on letterhead.
 



  





 THE CAREER SHAPE, AND THIS ONE IS NOT NEGOTIABLE
 



  





 We are looking for a specific arc, in a specific order. You started on the developer's or the contractor's side. You carried responsibility on a site, and you know what a delay costs because you have been the person who had to explain it. Then you moved into technical due diligence, lender's independent engineer, technical audit or project monitoring, where you learned to structure a problem, write for an executive and hold more than one project in your head at a time.
 



  





 The order matters more than either half. Someone who has only ever consulted writes a view that nobody on the ground respects, because it asks for things a site cannot give. Someone who has only ever been on site can hold a project but not a portfolio. We want depth first and structure second, and we want both.
 



  





 Bring the first half in detail. We will ask which sites, what your scope was, what the ground turned out to be and what it cost to deal with.
 



  





 QUALIFICATION
 



  





 \- A full\-time B.E. or B.Tech in Civil Engineering. This one is not negotiable and no other discipline substitutes.
 



 \- A postgraduate qualification is a strong plus rather than a requirement: NICMAR (ACM, APM or the QSCM diploma), RICS School of Built Environment, an IIT or NIT M.Tech in structural, geotechnical or construction engineering, and the NMIMS MBA (Tech.) in Civil Engineering with Operations Management. An MBA in Finance, a CFA or CA is an added advantage. Chartered or professional standing \- MRICS, Institution of Engineers (India), a valuer's registration, IGBC or LEED \- is read as evidence that you write to a standard someone else audits.
 



  





 TECHNICAL GROUNDING \- ESSENTIAL
 



  





 This is the part of the seat that cannot be learned on the job here, so we will test it directly, on a real drawing set and a real soil report.
 



  





 \- Ground and land form. Borelogs, SPT data, safe bearing capacity, settlement, water table, ground\-improvement options and what each one costs. Contours, cut and fill, approach gradients, and survey output read rather than taken on trust. You know what to specify to a geotechnical agency before they mobilise.
 



 \- Codes and authorities. IS 456, 800, 875 and 1893, the National Building Code, and the development control and industrial authority rules that bind a site.
 



 \- Warehousing and industrial specifics. Pre\-engineered buildings, portal frames, purlins and bracing, crane gantries, floor loading and flatness to the occupier's standard, fire strategy and sprinkler implications on the layout, and what an insurer's engineering requirements do to a design.
 



 \- Services and enabling. HT power, sanctioned load, distance to substation and what the discom will and will not do. Water source, sewage treatment, storm water outfall and where it legally goes.
 



 \- Cost. BOQ, rate analysis, running account bills, variation orders, escalation, retention and defect liability.
 



 \- Programme. Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project at critical\-path, float and resource\-loading level, with extension\-of\-time claims assessed on merit. Essential in this seat specifically, because reading a programme against physical reality is the job.
 



 \- Drawings. GFC review, structural and services coordination, and BIM clash detection at a level where you know what the model is hiding.
 



 \- Writing. A technical report a lender's credit committee or an investment committee can act on: findings, assumptions, quantified impact and a recommendation you will stand behind. Plus advanced Excel and PowerPoint.
 



 \- Platforms. Microsoft Project at working level, plus a background working in SAP, Primavera P6 or Project Online. We will ask which one, what you did in it and what it could not do.
 



  





 RELEVANT EXPERIENCE
 



  





 \- 8 to 12 years, the majority of it on or around sites rather than in a design office.
 



 \- At least three years on technical due diligence, independent engineer, technical audit or project monitoring work. Not delivery with a diligence assignment attached once.
 



 \- Sites assessed across greenfield land and built assets both. Assessing only completed buildings is half the seat.
 



 \- A report a lender, an investment committee or a buyer relied on to price or to walk away, and which held up afterwards.
 



 \- One constraint you found that nobody else had, and what it changed. This is the question the whole interview turns on.
 



 \- Specialist agencies instructed and marked, not merely coordinated.
 



  





 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 



  





 \- Not delivery or EPC, and not design. Execution is owned elsewhere and that seat is filled. You review what is proposed, you do not draw it and you do not build to it.
 



 \- Not the deal, and not portfolio governance. Investments owns underwriting and the register sits with the EPMO Lead. You supply the technical view into both, and you are expected to supply it even when it kills the deal.
 



 \- Not project accounting. Budget, forecast and variance sit with finance.
 



  





 HOW YOU WILL WORK
 



  





 Deliberately small, no departments. Survey, soil investigation, third\-party inspection and measurement all go to specialist agencies. What stays inside is the judgement about whether their work is any good and what it means for the money. Expect to be on site most weeks, and expect your written view to be read by the founder, the investment committee and, in time, by lenders.
 



  





 THE WORK IS YOURS TO DO
 



  





 We are not building an army. You do the work rather than receive it, route it and report on it. You walk the site yourself, brief the geotechnical agency yourself, take the drone output apart yourself and write the report in your own hand. You run your own tech stack rather than specifying it for someone else. Seniority changes what you are accountable for, not whether you roll up your sleeves.
